description: Men's fashion fit, proportion and silhouette rules for Urban Raja AI Stylist.

rules.name: Common men's clothing fits

slim.description: Clothing follows the body closely with minimal extra fabric.

regular.description: Clothing follows the natural body shape with moderate room.

relaxed.description: Clothing provides more room through the body and sleeves without being extremely oversized.

oversized.description: Clothing is intentionally larger than a standard fit with extra room and volume.

rules.styling_tip: Choose fit based on the intended silhouette, comfort, garment type and occasion rather than assuming one fit is always better.

rules.name: Men's t-shirt fit guidance

slim.description: Closer to the body with narrower sleeves and less fabric.

regular.description: Natural fit with comfortable room around the chest and waist.

boxy.description: Shorter or moderate body length with a wider body and broader visual shape.

oversized.description: Intentionally loose with extra room through the body and sleeves.

rules.styling_tip: When recommending a t-shirt fit, consider the desired silhouette and balance it with the fit and volume of the bottom.

rules.name: Common men's jeans fits

skinny.description: Very close-fitting through the thigh, knee and lower leg.

slim.description: Fitted through the thigh with a narrower leg while allowing more room than skinny jeans.

straight.description: Similar width from the thigh through the leg with a relatively consistent shape.

relaxed.description: More room through the seat and thigh with a comfortable leg shape.

baggy.description: Intentionally loose with substantial extra volume through the leg.

rules.styling_tip: Choose jeans fit according to the desired silhouette and balance the volume of the top and footwear.

rules.name: Common men's shirt fits

slim.description: Closer to the body with a narrower cut through the chest and waist.

regular.description: Follows the natural body shape with comfortable room.

relaxed.description: Provides additional room through the chest, waist and sleeves without being extremely oversized.

oversized.description: Intentionally larger with extra width, length or sleeve volume.

rules.styling_tip: For a balanced outfit, consider the shirt's volume together with the bottom fit and the intended occasion.

rules.name: Common men's trouser fits

slim.description: Closer-fitting through the thigh and leg with limited extra fabric.

straight.description: A relatively consistent width from the thigh toward the hem.

relaxed.description: Provides additional room through the seat, thigh and leg.

wide_leg.description: Features noticeably wider legs with substantial volume from the thigh toward the hem.

rules.styling_tip: Balance trouser volume with the top and footwear. Wider trousers can work especially well with tops that have enough visual structure or volume to maintain overall balance.

rules.name: Balance top and bottom volume
rules.guideline: The visual volume of the top and bottom should work together to create an intentional overall silhouette.

fitted_top_fitted_bottom.description: Creates a close and streamlined silhouette.

fitted_top_relaxed_bottom.description: Creates contrast between a closer top and a roomier bottom.

oversized_top_straight_bottom.description: Balances a loose upper body with a relatively structured lower silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: There is no single correct proportion. Choose the balance according to the intended silhouette, garment structure, comfort and personal style.

rules.name: Styling oversized t-shirts with bottoms
rules.guideline: An oversized t-shirt creates additional volume in the upper body, so the bottom can be selected to either balance or intentionally extend that relaxed silhouette.

oversized_tshirt_relaxed_trousers.effect: Relaxed and comfortable silhouette with moderate volume.

oversized_tshirt_slim_jeans.effect: Creates stronger contrast between a loose top and narrow bottom.

rules.styling_tip: When both top and bottom are highly voluminous, keep footwear and accessories relatively simple to maintain visual control.

rules.name: Shirt and trouser fit balance
rules.guideline: The shirt and trouser fits should work together according to the intended silhouette and occasion.
rules.styling_tip: For formal settings, structured and controlled fits are generally easier to coordinate. For casual styling, relaxed proportions can be used more freely.

rules.name: Layering and silhouette balance
rules.guideline: When layering multiple garments, consider the volume, length and structure of each layer so the overall silhouette remains intentional.

fitted_base_relaxed_outer.effect: Creates a controlled base with a more relaxed outer silhouette.

regular_base_regular_outer.effect: Creates a balanced and versatile layered silhouette.

oversized_base_fitted_outer.effect: Can create visual tension because the inner layer has more volume than the outer layer.

rules.styling_tip: Avoid excessive fabric bunching around the shoulders, waist or sleeves. Layer lengths should also work together rather than competing visually.

rules.name: T-shirt length guidance
rules.guideline: T-shirt length affects the overall proportion of the outfit and should work with the rise and fit of the bottom.

shorter_length.description: Creates a visually shorter upper body and can work well with higher-rise bottoms.

regular_length.description: Provides a balanced proportion for everyday outfits.

longer_length.description: Creates additional visual length in the upper body and can contribute to a relaxed silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Avoid choosing length based only on the label. Consider the bottom's rise, the garment's overall width and the intended silhouette.

rules.name: Jeans length and hem break
rules.guideline: The length of jeans affects the visual proportion and how the footwear interacts with the outfit.

no_break.description: The hem ends around the shoe with little or no fabric stacking.

slight_break.description: The hem creates a small amount of fabric at the top of the shoe.

stacked.description: Extra fabric gathers around the ankle and shoe.

rules.styling_tip: The ideal hem depends on the jeans fit, footwear, rise and intended silhouette. Avoid excessive bunching unless a stacked look is intentional.

rules.name: Trouser rise guidance
rules.guideline: The rise of trousers affects waist placement, leg proportions and how the top and bottom visually connect.

low_rise.description: Sits lower on the waist and creates a longer visual upper-body proportion.

mid_rise.description: Sits around the natural waist area and provides a balanced proportion.

high_rise.description: Sits higher on the waist and can create a longer visual leg line with a shorter-looking upper body.

rules.styling_tip: Choose the rise based on the intended proportion, top length, body comfort and garment silhouette rather than treating one rise as universally better.

rules.name: Shoulder fit guidance
rules.guideline: Shoulder placement strongly affects how structured, fitted or oversized a top appears.

fitted_shoulder.description: The shoulder seam sits close to the natural shoulder edge.
fitted_shoulder.visual_effect: Creates a clean and structured appearance.

slightly_dropped_shoulder.description: The shoulder seam sits slightly beyond the natural shoulder edge.
slightly_dropped_shoulder.visual_effect: Creates a relaxed and contemporary appearance.

strong_dropped_shoulder.description: The shoulder seam extends noticeably beyond the natural shoulder edge.
strong_dropped_shoulder.visual_effect: Creates a clearly oversized and high-volume silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Shoulder width should be considered together with garment width and sleeve length. A dropped shoulder does not automatically mean the garment is oversized.

rules.name: Sleeve length guidance
rules.guideline: Sleeve length affects the visual balance of the upper body and should match the garment's intended fit and silhouette.

short_sleeve.description: Ends around the upper arm and creates a clean, fitted appearance.

mid_sleeve.description: Extends further down the upper arm and works well with relaxed proportions.

long_short_sleeve.description: Extends closer to or slightly below the elbow, creating a more oversized visual proportion.

rules.styling_tip: Consider sleeve length together with shoulder width, garment width and overall length. Excessively long sleeves can make a regular-fit garment appear unintentionally oversized.

rules.name: Trouser length guidance
rules.guideline: Trouser length affects the visual line of the legs and should work with the trouser width and footwear.

cropped.description: Ends above the ankle and leaves more of the footwear visible.

full_length_no_break.description: Reaches the footwear with little or no fabric folding at the hem.

slight_break.description: Creates a small fold where the trouser hem meets the footwear.

stacked.description: Extra fabric gathers around the ankle and footwear.

rules.styling_tip: Choose trouser length together with leg width, footwear height and intended silhouette. Excessive stacking can make the outfit look untidy unless it is intentional.

rules.name: Shirt length and tuck guidance
rules.guideline: Shirt length and tucking change the visual proportion between the upper and lower body.

untucked.description: Keeps the shirt outside the trousers and creates a relaxed continuous silhouette.

half_tuck.description: Only part of the shirt is tucked, creating an intentionally relaxed and asymmetric appearance.

full_tuck.description: The shirt is tucked completely into the trousers, creating a cleaner waist definition.

long_shirt.description: A longer shirt creates additional upper-body length and a more relaxed silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Choose the tuck and shirt length based on the shirt cut, trouser rise, garment proportions and occasion. Avoid excessive fabric bunching around the waist.

rules.name: Footwear and trouser proportion guidance
rules.guideline: The visual weight of footwear should work with the width and volume of the trousers.

slim_trousers.description: Narrow trousers generally pair well with footwear that has a streamlined or moderate visual shape.

straight_trousers.description: Straight-leg trousers provide flexibility and can work with both streamlined and moderately substantial footwear.

wide_trousers.description: Wider trousers can be balanced by footwear with moderate or substantial visual volume.

rules.styling_tip: Consider the overall silhouette rather than matching footwear size strictly to trouser width. The goal is visual balance between the lower-leg volume and footwear.

rules.name: Fit consistency across layers
rules.guideline: Multiple clothing layers should have enough room to sit comfortably together without unwanted bunching or restriction.

fitted_base_relaxed_outer.description: A closer-fitting inner layer leaves room for a relaxed outer layer to sit cleanly.

regular_base_regular_outer.description: Similar moderate fits create a balanced and straightforward layered silhouette.

relaxed_base_relaxed_outer.description: Roomier layers create a comfortable silhouette while maintaining intentional volume.

oversized_base_oversized_outer.description: High-volume layers create a strong oversized silhouette and require attention to length and fabric volume.

rules.styling_tip: Check shoulder room, sleeve room, body width and layer lengths together. Each layer should move comfortably without excessive bunching.

rules.name: Trouser waist and seat fit guidance
rules.guideline: Trousers should sit securely at the waist and provide enough room through the seat for comfortable movement without excessive fabric.

proper_waist.description: The waistband sits securely without needing excessive tightening or creating visible pressure marks.
proper_waist.visual_effect: Creates a clean and controlled fit around the waist.

proper_seat.description: The seat has enough room for natural movement without excessive pulling or sagging.
proper_seat.visual_effect: Keeps the trouser silhouette clean and comfortable.

too_tight.description: Visible pulling or tension around the waistband, seat or upper thigh indicates insufficient room.
too_tight.visual_effect: Can disrupt the intended trouser silhouette.

too_loose.description: Excess fabric or noticeable sagging around the waist and seat can make the trousers look unstructured.
too_loose.visual_effect: Can reduce the clarity of the intended silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Judge waist and seat fit together with the trouser rise and leg shape. A relaxed or baggy fit should have intentional volume, not an insecure or poorly fitting waistband.

rules.name: Sleeve width guidance
rules.guideline: Sleeve width contributes to the overall upper-body volume and should support the intended garment silhouette.

narrow_sleeve.description: Closer around the arm with limited extra fabric.
narrow_sleeve.visual_effect: Creates a sharper and more fitted appearance.

regular_sleeve.description: Provides moderate room around the arm without excessive volume.

wide_sleeve.description: Provides noticeably more room around the arm and contributes to a relaxed upper-body silhouette.
wide_sleeve.visual_effect: Creates a more contemporary and relaxed appearance.

very_wide_sleeve.description: Creates substantial sleeve volume and is usually associated with intentionally oversized garments.

rules.styling_tip: Consider sleeve width together with shoulder placement, sleeve length and body width. One measurement alone should not determine whether a garment is oversized.

rules.name: Pant hem width guidance
rules.guideline: The width of the pant opening affects how the lower leg connects visually with the footwear.

narrow_hem.description: A narrower opening creates a streamlined lower-leg appearance.

regular_hem.description: A moderate opening creates a balanced connection between the trouser leg and footwear.

wide_hem.description: A wider opening creates more visual volume around the ankle and shoe.

rules.styling_tip: The hem width should be considered with the full leg shape, trouser length and footwear. A wide hem does not automatically require chunky footwear.

rules.name: T-shirt neckline guidance
rules.guideline: The neckline affects the visual shape of the upper body and should complement the overall garment fit and styling intent.

crew_neck.description: A rounded neckline that provides a classic and versatile appearance.

v_neck.description: A V-shaped neckline that creates more visible space around the neck.

deep_v_neck.description: A more pronounced V shape that creates a stronger and more open neckline.

henley_neck.description: A partial button opening below a rounded neckline that adds subtle structure and detail.

rules.styling_tip: Choose the neckline based on the garment design, overall fit, occasion and desired visual effect rather than treating one neckline as universally better.

rules.name: Jacket and overshirt length guidance
rules.guideline: Outerwear length affects the overall proportion of the outfit and should work with the layers underneath and the bottom's rise.

cropped_outerwear.description: Ends around the waist or upper hip, creating a shorter upper-body proportion and making the legs appear visually longer.

regular_length_outerwear.description: Ends around the hip area and provides a balanced proportion for everyday layering.

long_outerwear.description: Extends further down the hip or toward the thigh, creating a longer layered silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider outerwear length together with the inner layer length, trouser rise and overall silhouette. Avoid excessive overlapping lengths that create unnecessary visual bulk.

rules.name: Fit guidance by occasion
rules.guideline: The appropriate fit depends on the occasion, dress code, comfort and intended style.

formal.description: Controlled and structured fits generally create a polished appearance.

smart_casual.description: Moderate structure with some comfort and room works well.

college.description: Casual and contemporary fits can work depending on personal style.

casual.description: Comfortable and relaxed silhouettes offer flexibility for everyday outfits.

streetwear.description: Intentional volume and relaxed proportions are commonly used.

rules.styling_tip: These are general guidelines, not strict rules. Personal style, garment design, comfort and the specific dress code should also be considered.

rules.name: T-shirt body width guidance
rules.guideline: The body width of a T-shirt is a major factor in defining whether the silhouette looks fitted, regular, boxy or oversized.

narrow_width.description: Closer to the torso with limited extra fabric through the chest and waist.
narrow_width.visual_effect: Creates a fitted and streamlined appearance.

regular_width.description: Provides moderate room through the chest and waist without excessive fabric.

wide_width.description: Provides noticeably more room through the torso and contributes to a broader silhouette.
wide_width.visual_effect: Creates a relaxed or boxy appearance.

very_wide_width.description: Creates substantial extra room through the torso and is commonly used for intentionally oversized silhouettes.

rules.styling_tip: Judge body width together with shoulder placement, sleeve width and T-shirt length. Width alone should not determine the garment's fit category.

rules.name: Jeans thigh fit guidance
rules.guideline: The amount of room through the thigh affects comfort and contributes to the overall jeans silhouette.

close_thigh.description: The fabric follows the thigh closely with limited extra room.
close_thigh.visual_effect: Creates a fitted and streamlined appearance.

moderate_thigh_room.description: Provides balanced room through the thigh without looking loose.
moderate_thigh_room.visual_effect: Creates a versatile and natural silhouette.

relaxed_thigh.description: Provides noticeable additional room through the thigh for comfort and a looser silhouette.
relaxed_thigh.visual_effect: Creates a relaxed and effortless appearance.

high_volume_thigh.description: Provides substantial extra room through the thigh as part of an intentionally loose silhouette.
high_volume_thigh.visual_effect: Creates a strong relaxed or oversized lower-body appearance.

rules.styling_tip: Evaluate thigh room together with the seat, knee, leg width and overall jeans silhouette. Extra room should look intentional rather than poorly fitted.

rules.name: Jeans knee shape guidance
rules.guideline: The shape and room around the knee influence how smoothly the jeans transition from the thigh to the lower leg.

close_knee.description: The fabric stays close around the knee with limited extra room.
close_knee.visual_effect: Creates a sharp and streamlined lower-body silhouette.

balanced_knee.description: Provides moderate room around the knee while maintaining a clear leg shape.
balanced_knee.visual_effect: Creates a balanced and versatile silhouette.

relaxed_knee.description: Provides additional room around the knee and allows the leg to maintain a looser shape.
relaxed_knee.visual_effect: Creates a relaxed and comfortable appearance.

wide_knee.description: Maintains substantial width around the knee as part of a high-volume leg shape.
wide_knee.visual_effect: Creates a distinctly loose and fashion-forward silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider knee width together with thigh fit, hem width and overall leg shape. The transition should look intentional from the upper leg through the hem.

rules.name: Shirt sleeve length guidance
rules.guideline: Shirt sleeve length affects the balance of the upper body and should match the shirt's fit and intended styling.

short_sleeve.description: Ends around the upper arm and creates a casual, lightweight appearance.

elbow_length.description: Extends toward the elbow and creates a more relaxed visual proportion.

long_sleeve.description: Extends toward the wrist and provides a more structured and versatile appearance.

rules.styling_tip: Consider sleeve length together with shoulder fit, sleeve width, shirt body width and whether the shirt is tucked or untucked.

rules.name: Trouser and shoe coverage guidance
rules.guideline: How the trouser hem sits over the footwear changes the visual connection between the trousers and shoes.

ankle_exposed.description: The trouser hem sits above the shoe and leaves part of the ankle or sock area visible.

shoe_touching.description: The hem meets the footwear with little fabric covering the shoe.

light_shoe_overlap.description: The trouser hem slightly overlaps the upper part of the footwear.

heavy_shoe_overlap.description: The trouser hem covers a noticeable portion of the footwear and may create additional fabric folds.

rules.styling_tip: Consider shoe coverage together with trouser length, hem width and footwear height. Excessive coverage can hide the footwear and create unwanted bulk.

rules.name: Shirt collar proportion guidance
rules.guideline: Collar size and structure influence how the upper part of a shirt looks and should work with the shirt's overall proportions.

small_collar.description: A compact collar creates a subtle and lightweight appearance around the neck.

medium_collar.description: Provides a balanced collar proportion that works across many shirt styles.

wide_collar.description: Creates a stronger visual presence around the neckline.

rules.styling_tip: Consider collar size together with shirt fit, neckline, face framing and overall garment proportions. Collar size alone should not determine whether a shirt looks formal or casual.

rules.name: Jacket shoulder structure guidance
rules.guideline: The shoulder structure of a jacket affects how sharp, relaxed or oversized the upper-body silhouette appears.

structured_shoulder.description: The shoulder maintains a defined shape with controlled construction.
structured_shoulder.visual_effect: Creates a sharper and more polished upper-body silhouette.

natural_shoulder.description: The jacket follows the natural shoulder shape with minimal added structure.
natural_shoulder.visual_effect: Creates a softer and more relaxed appearance.

dropped_shoulder.description: The shoulder seam extends beyond the natural shoulder edge.
dropped_shoulder.visual_effect: Creates a relaxed and contemporary silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Judge jacket shoulder structure together with jacket width, sleeve length and layering room. A structured shoulder and a slim fit are related but are not the same thing.

rules.name: T-shirt shoulder-to-body balance
rules.guideline: Shoulder placement and body width should work together to create the intended T-shirt silhouette.

fitted_balance.description: Shoulder placement stays close to the natural shoulder while the body remains relatively narrow.
fitted_balance.visual_effect: Creates a clean and streamlined silhouette.

regular_balance.description: Natural shoulder placement combines with moderate body width.

boxy_balance.description: A slightly wider body works with a shorter or moderately dropped shoulder to create a broader shape.
boxy_balance.visual_effect: Creates a structured but relaxed silhouette.

oversized_balance.description: A wider body combines with noticeably dropped shoulders and additional sleeve volume.

rules.styling_tip: Evaluate shoulder placement, body width, sleeve width and garment length together. An oversized appearance usually comes from the combination of several proportions rather than one measurement.

rules.name: Jeans leg shape guidance
rules.guideline: The shape of the jeans leg from thigh to hem determines the overall lower-body silhouette.

tapered_leg.description: The leg gradually becomes narrower toward the hem.
tapered_leg.visual_effect: Creates a streamlined and slightly fitted lower-body silhouette.

straight_leg.description: The leg maintains a relatively consistent width from thigh toward the hem.
straight_leg.visual_effect: Creates a balanced and timeless silhouette.

relaxed_leg.description: The leg maintains additional room from thigh through the lower leg.
relaxed_leg.visual_effect: Creates a comfortable and relaxed silhouette.

wide_leg.description: The leg remains noticeably wide through most of its length.
wide_leg.visual_effect: Creates a flowing and high-volume lower-body silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Judge leg shape together with thigh room, knee width, hem width and length. The complete leg profile matters more than any single measurement.

rules.name: Trouser crease and structure guidance
rules.guideline: The presence and sharpness of a trouser crease can change the visual structure of the legs.

sharp_crease.description: A clearly defined vertical crease creates a more structured leg line.
sharp_crease.visual_effect: Makes the trousers appear polished and tailored.

soft_crease.description: A subtle or naturally formed crease provides some structure without looking highly formal.
soft_crease.visual_effect: Creates a relaxed but refined appearance.

no_crease.description: The trouser fabric falls naturally without a defined central crease.
no_crease.visual_effect: Creates a softer and more casual appearance.

rules.styling_tip: Crease choice should match the trouser fabric, construction and occasion. A crease does not determine the fit category by itself.

rules.name: Belt and waist proportion guidance
rules.guideline: The belt should visually support the trouser waist and coordinate with the overall outfit without creating unnecessary bulk.

slim_belt.description: A narrower belt creates a subtle waist detail and works well with streamlined outfits.

medium_belt.description: A moderate-width belt provides a balanced waist detail for versatile outfits.

substantial_belt.description: A wider or visually heavier belt creates a stronger waist detail.

rules.styling_tip: Choose belt width according to trouser loops, garment proportions and outfit style. The belt should sit securely without excessive tightening or bunching around the waist.

rules.name: Hoodie fit and proportion guidance
rules.guideline: Hoodie width, shoulder placement and length work together to determine the overall casual silhouette.

regular_hoodie.description: Provides moderate room through the body and sleeves while maintaining a balanced shape.

relaxed_hoodie.description: Provides additional room through the body and sleeves without creating extreme volume.

oversized_hoodie.description: Uses increased body width, dropped shoulders and additional sleeve volume for an intentionally larger silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider hoodie width, shoulder drop, sleeve length and body length together. Pair the overall volume with a bottom silhouette that creates the intended proportion.

rules.name: Sweatshirt fit and proportion guidance
rules.guideline: A sweatshirt's body width, shoulder placement, sleeve volume and length determine its overall silhouette.

regular_sweatshirt.description: Provides moderate room through the body and sleeves for a balanced everyday fit.

relaxed_sweatshirt.description: Provides additional room through the body and sleeves while maintaining a controlled silhouette.

oversized_sweatshirt.description: Uses increased width, dropped shoulders and additional sleeve volume for an intentionally larger silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Evaluate sweatshirt width, shoulder placement, sleeve volume and length together. The bottom fit should support the intended overall volume.

rules.name: Shorts length guidance
rules.guideline: Shorts length changes the visual proportion of the legs and should work with the shorts width and footwear.

short_length.description: Ends higher on the thigh and creates a shorter, more open leg silhouette.

mid_length.description: Ends around the mid-thigh and provides a balanced casual proportion.

long_length.description: Extends closer to the knee and creates a more covered and relaxed lower-body appearance.

rules.styling_tip: Choose shorts length according to leg proportion, shorts width, footwear and intended style. Avoid excessive length or tightness that conflicts with the desired silhouette.

rules.name: Shorts fit guidance
rules.guideline: Shorts width through the seat, thigh and leg opening determines whether the silhouette looks fitted, regular or relaxed.

slim_shorts.description: Closer through the seat and thigh with a narrower leg opening.
slim_shorts.visual_effect: Creates a clean and streamlined appearance.

regular_shorts.description: Provides moderate room through the seat and thigh with a balanced leg opening.

relaxed_shorts.description: Provides additional room through the seat and thigh with a wider leg opening.
relaxed_shorts.visual_effect: Creates a comfortable and relaxed appearance.

oversized_shorts.description: Uses substantial width and volume for an intentionally loose silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Judge shorts fit together with their length, rise and leg opening. Extra width should look intentional and remain comfortable during movement.

rules.name: Knitwear fit guidance
rules.guideline: Knitwear fit should account for fabric drape, stretch and layering space in addition to the intended silhouette.

fitted_knitwear.description: Sits closer to the body with limited extra fabric and creates a defined silhouette.

regular_knitwear.description: Provides moderate room and allows comfortable movement without excessive volume.

relaxed_knitwear.description: Provides additional room through the body and sleeves while maintaining a controlled shape.

oversized_knitwear.description: Uses increased width and volume for an intentionally loose silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider the knit's thickness and stretch when judging fit. A thicker knit may need additional room for comfortable layering without looking unnecessarily oversized.

rules.name: Blazer length and proportion guidance
rules.guideline: Blazer length affects the balance between the upper and lower body and should work with the trouser rise and overall tailoring.

short_blazer.description: Ends higher around the hip and creates a shorter upper-body proportion.

regular_blazer.description: Provides a balanced length around the hip and creates a traditional tailored proportion.

long_blazer.description: Extends further over the hip and creates a longer, more relaxed upper-body silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Judge blazer length together with shoulder structure, jacket width, sleeve length and trouser rise. The hem should support the intended tailored proportion rather than follow a fixed length rule.

rules.name: Overshirt fit and length guidance
rules.guideline: An overshirt is designed for layering, so its width and length should allow the inner layer to sit comfortably underneath.

regular_overshirt.description: Provides moderate layering room while maintaining a controlled silhouette.

relaxed_overshirt.description: Provides additional room through the body and sleeves for comfortable layering.

oversized_overshirt.description: Uses increased width, dropped shoulders and additional length for a more pronounced layered silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: The overshirt should generally have enough room for the inner layer without excessive bunching. Consider its width, shoulder placement, sleeve length and hem together.

rules.name: Kurta fit and length guidance
rules.guideline: Kurta width and length strongly influence its traditional or contemporary silhouette and should work with the bottom style.

straight_regular_kurta.description: Provides a relatively straight body shape with moderate room and a controlled length.

relaxed_kurta.description: Provides additional room through the body and creates a more comfortable flowing silhouette.

short_kurta.description: Ends higher around the hip or upper thigh and creates a more contemporary proportion.

long_kurta.description: Extends further down the thigh and creates a more traditional or flowing silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider kurta length together with its width, bottom style and footwear. The intended silhouette should remain comfortable and proportionate rather than relying on one fixed length.

rules.name: Kurta and bottom proportion guidance
rules.guideline: The bottom worn with a kurta changes the overall silhouette and should balance the kurta's length and volume.

kurta_with_churidar.description: A relatively narrow bottom creates contrast with the flowing upper garment.

kurta_with_straight_pants.description: A straight bottom creates a balanced and structured ethnic silhouette.

kurta_with_relaxed_pants.description: A roomier bottom creates a softer and more relaxed overall silhouette.

short_kurta_with_jeans.description: A shorter kurta combined with jeans creates a contemporary fusion silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Balance the kurta's length and volume with the bottom's width. If both pieces are highly voluminous, keep footwear and other styling elements relatively simple.

rules.name: Matching set proportion guidance
rules.guideline: Matching tops and bottoms create a continuous visual line, so their fit and volume should work together.

regular_matching_set.description: A moderate top and bottom fit creates a balanced and coordinated silhouette.

relaxed_matching_set.description: A roomier top and bottom create a comfortable continuous silhouette without extreme volume.

oversized_matching_set.description: Both pieces use increased volume to create a deliberately loose and fashion-forward silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: When both pieces have similar volume, use footwear and accessories to maintain visual balance. Avoid excessive fabric volume that hides the intended silhouette.

rules.name: Monochrome outfit fit guidance
rules.guideline: Using similar colours across the outfit creates visual continuity, so differences in fit and volume become more noticeable.

same_fit_monochrome.description: Similar fit levels across the outfit create a consistent and controlled silhouette.

fitted_top_relaxed_bottom.description: A closer upper layer contrasts with a roomier lower half while the similar colour palette keeps the outfit visually connected.

relaxed_top_straight_bottom.description: A roomier upper layer combined with a more structured bottom creates controlled contrast.

oversized_top_baggy_bottom.description: Both pieces use high volume while the similar colour palette creates one continuous large silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: When using similar colours from head to toe, use fit, texture or footwear shape to create visual definition between different parts of the outfit.

rules.name: Tucked and untucked proportion guidance
rules.guideline: Tucking changes where the visual boundary between the top and bottom appears and can alter the perceived body-to-leg proportion.

untucked.description: Keeps the top covering part of the waistband and creates a continuous upper-body silhouette.

full_tuck.description: Reveals the waistband and creates a clearer separation between the top and bottom.

half_tuck.description: Creates an intentionally uneven visual boundary between the top and bottom.

rules.styling_tip: Consider the top length, trouser rise, top volume and occasion together. A tuck should support the intended proportion rather than being used as a fixed rule for a particular body type.

rules.name: Layer length hierarchy guidance
rules.guideline: When multiple layers are worn together, their lengths should create a deliberate visual order rather than random overlap.

short_inner_long_outer.description: A shorter inner layer sits underneath a longer outer layer, creating a clean outer silhouette.

long_inner_short_outer.description: A longer inner layer extends below the outer layer and creates a visible layered hem.

similar_layer_lengths.description: Layers finish at similar points, creating a compact and controlled silhouette.

graduated_lengths.description: Each layer finishes at a different length, creating visible depth between the garments.

rules.styling_tip: Avoid accidental-looking overlaps or excessive bunching. Layer lengths should work with garment volume, bottom rise and the overall silhouette.

rules.name: Fabric drape and fit guidance
rules.guideline: Fabric weight, stiffness and drape can change how the same garment measurements appear on the body.

structured_fabric.description: Stiffer fabrics hold their shape and create clearer garment edges.
structured_fabric.visual_effect: Creates a more defined and structured silhouette.

medium_drape.description: Fabric follows the body with moderate movement while retaining some structure.
medium_drape.visual_effect: Creates a balanced and versatile silhouette.

soft_drape.description: Light or fluid fabrics fall naturally and create more movement around the body.
soft_drape.visual_effect: Creates a softer and more relaxed silhouette.

heavy_fabric.description: Heavier materials add visual weight and can make a garment appear more substantial.
heavy_fabric.visual_effect: Creates a stronger and more substantial silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Judge fit together with fabric behaviour. A garment with the same measurements can look more fitted, relaxed or structured depending on fabric weight and drape.

rules.name: Fabric stretch and ease guidance
rules.guideline: Fabric stretch affects how much movement a garment allows, while ease determines the amount of space between the body and garment.

low_stretch.description: Provides little additional flexibility, so sufficient garment room is important for comfortable movement.

moderate_stretch.description: Provides some flexibility while maintaining the garment's intended shape.

high_stretch.description: Allows greater movement and can accommodate a closer fit without the same restriction as rigid fabric.

extra_ease.description: Additional space between the body and garment creates more freedom of movement and a relaxed appearance.

rules.styling_tip: Do not judge fit from measurements alone. Consider fabric stretch, ease, movement requirements and the intended silhouette together.

rules.name: Pocket placement and proportion guidance
rules.guideline: Pocket size and placement can affect the visual balance of a garment and should work with its overall fit.

small_pockets.description: Smaller pockets create a subtle detail without adding much visual weight.

standard_pockets.description: Moderate pocket size provides functional detail while maintaining balanced proportions.

large_pockets.description: Larger pockets add noticeable visual weight and can contribute to a utility or oversized appearance.

balanced_placement.description: Pockets positioned consistently with the garment's chest, waist or thigh area maintain visual balance.

rules.styling_tip: Consider pocket size and placement together with garment width and intended silhouette. Large pockets can add visual bulk even when the garment itself is not oversized.

rules.name: Hood volume and proportion guidance
rules.guideline: Hood size and structure affect the visual volume around the neck and upper body.

compact_hood.description: A smaller hood sits closer to the neck and creates a cleaner upper-body appearance.

medium_hood.description: Provides balanced coverage around the neck without adding excessive visual volume.

large_hood.description: Creates noticeable volume around the neck and upper back, contributing to a more relaxed silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Judge hood volume together with hoodie width, shoulder drop and sleeve volume. A large hood can make the upper body appear more substantial even when the hoodie body is moderate.

rules.name: Garment ease guidance
rules.guideline: Garment ease is the space between the body and clothing and strongly affects how fitted or relaxed a garment appears.

minimal_ease.description: Provides limited extra room around the body and creates a closer, more defined silhouette.

moderate_ease.description: Provides comfortable room while maintaining a controlled garment shape.

generous_ease.description: Provides noticeable additional room and creates a relaxed silhouette without necessarily being oversized.

excessive_ease.description: Creates substantial additional space and contributes to a clearly oversized or high-volume silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Judge ease together with fabric stretch, garment width, shoulder placement and length. Extra room should look intentional rather than simply oversized.

rules.name: Jacket buttoning and closure proportion guidance
rules.guideline: The position and number of jacket closures can change the visual balance of the torso and should work with the jacket's cut.

single_button.description: A single central closure creates a clean and elongated visual line through the torso.

two_button.description: Two closures create a balanced and versatile front structure with a defined waist area.

double_breasted.description: Overlapping front panels create greater visual width and a more substantial upper-body appearance.

open_closure.description: Wearing the jacket open removes the central closure emphasis and creates a more relaxed layered silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider closure style together with jacket length, lapel width, shoulder structure and overall jacket fit. Button placement should support the intended torso proportion rather than follow a universal rule.

rules.name: Cargo pocket volume and proportion guidance
rules.guideline: Cargo pocket size and placement add visual volume to the lower body and should work with the trouser silhouette.

flat_pockets.description: Low-profile pockets add utility without significantly increasing the visual volume of the trousers.

moderate_pockets.description: Medium-sized pockets add visible utility detail while maintaining a balanced trouser silhouette.

large_pockets.description: Large or gusseted pockets add noticeable volume around the thighs and contribute to a stronger utility silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider cargo pocket volume together with thigh room, leg width and trouser length. Multiple large pockets can make the lower body look visually heavier, so balance the upper-body volume accordingly.

rules.name: Knit gauge and thickness guidance
rules.guideline: Knit thickness and gauge affect how much visual and physical volume knitwear adds to the body.

fine_gauge.description: Thin, closely knitted fabric creates a lighter and more streamlined appearance.

medium_gauge.description: Moderate thickness provides some structure while remaining versatile for everyday wear.

chunky_gauge.description: Thicker knit construction adds noticeable texture and physical volume to the silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider knit thickness together with fit and layering space. A thick knit can appear more oversized even when its measured width is similar to a thinner garment.

rules.name: Kurta sleeve fit guidance
rules.guideline: Kurta sleeve width and length affect the balance between the upper body and the overall ethnic silhouette.

fitted_sleeve.description: The sleeve follows the arm more closely and creates a cleaner, more structured appearance.

regular_sleeve.description: Provides moderate room around the arm while maintaining a balanced silhouette.

relaxed_sleeve.description: Provides additional room and creates a softer, more comfortable upper-body silhouette.

wide_sleeve.description: Creates noticeable sleeve volume and contributes to a more contemporary or flowing silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider sleeve width and length together with kurta body width, shoulder fit and overall kurta length. Sleeve volume should support the intended ethnic silhouette rather than overpower it.

rules.name: Shirt placket proportion guidance
rules.guideline: The shirt placket adds a vertical visual element to the front of the garment and should work with the shirt's overall proportions.

minimal_placket.description: A clean and narrow front opening creates a subtle vertical detail without adding much visual weight.

standard_placket.description: A conventional front button area provides balanced structure and works across common shirt silhouettes.

wide_or_statement_placket.description: A wider or visually prominent front opening adds stronger detail and can increase the visual presence of the upper body.

open_placket.description: Leaving one or more upper buttons open creates a more relaxed neckline and reduces the formal appearance of the shirt.

rules.styling_tip: Consider the placket together with shirt width, collar size, neckline opening and overall garment proportion. A stronger front detail works best when the rest of the shirt remains visually balanced.

rules.name: Trouser pleat and front volume guidance
rules.guideline: Pleats change the amount of fabric and visual volume around the front of the trousers and should work with the overall trouser silhouette.

flat_front.description: A flat front has minimal extra fabric at the waist and creates a cleaner, streamlined appearance.

single_pleat.description: One pleat adds moderate room and creates a softer front shape around the upper thigh.

double_pleat.description: Two pleats add more front volume and allow a roomier upper-thigh silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider pleat structure together with trouser rise, thigh room, leg width and fabric drape. Added front volume should look intentional and remain comfortable while moving.

rules.name: Jacket sleeve length guidance
rules.guideline: Jacket sleeve length affects the relationship between the jacket, inner layer and hands and should match the jacket's intended structure.

short_jacket_sleeve.description: Ends higher on the wrist and can create a more contemporary or casual proportion.

regular_jacket_sleeve.description: Reaches around the wrist and provides a balanced proportion for most jackets.

long_jacket_sleeve.description: Extends noticeably beyond the wrist and creates a less structured appearance if not intentionally designed that way.

rules.styling_tip: Judge jacket sleeve length together with shoulder structure, sleeve width and the inner layer. Excessive length can hide the hands and disrupt the intended jacket proportion.

rules.name: Garment length layering guidance
rules.guideline: When garments overlap, the visible difference between their lengths affects layering depth and overall proportion.

minimal_length_difference.description: Layers finish close together, creating a compact and controlled appearance.

moderate_length_difference.description: One layer extends noticeably beyond another, creating clear visual separation and depth.

strong_length_difference.description: A large difference between layer lengths creates a prominent layered silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Use intentional length differences when layering. Consider garment volume, bottom rise and fabric thickness so overlapping layers do not create unnecessary bulk.

rules.name: Trouser break and footwear guidance
rules.guideline: The amount of trouser break should work with the footwear shape and the intended outfit silhouette.

no_break_with_low_profile_shoes.description: A clean hem with minimal folding works naturally with streamlined footwear.

slight_break_with_standard_shoes.description: A small fold provides a versatile transition between trousers and moderately shaped footwear.

stacking_with_substantial_shoes.description: Additional fabric at the hem can work with footwear that has greater visual volume.

rules.styling_tip: Consider trouser width, length, hem width and footwear shape together. Avoid excessive fabric buildup unless the stacked silhouette is intentional.

rules.name: Shirt body length guidance
rules.guideline: Shirt body length affects upper-body proportion and should work with the shirt's width, bottom rise and wearing method.

short_body_length.description: Ends around the upper hip and creates a shorter, more contemporary upper-body proportion.

regular_body_length.description: Provides balanced coverage around the hip and works across many everyday shirt silhouettes.

long_body_length.description: Provides additional coverage over the hip and creates a longer, more relaxed upper-body silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Judge shirt length together with body width, trouser rise and whether the shirt is tucked or untucked. Length should support the intended silhouette without creating unnecessary fabric.

rules.name: Trouser leg opening guidance
rules.guideline: The leg opening determines how the trouser hem frames the ankle and footwear and should match the overall leg shape.

narrow_opening.description: Creates a closer transition around the ankle and gives the lower leg a streamlined appearance.

regular_opening.description: Provides a balanced amount of space around the ankle and works with a variety of footwear.

wide_opening.description: Creates additional visual volume around the ankle and allows more of the footwear to sit inside the trouser silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider leg opening together with thigh room, knee width, trouser length and footwear shape. The complete leg profile should look intentional from thigh to hem.

rules.name: Jacket body width guidance
rules.guideline: Jacket body width determines how close or relaxed the torso appears and should provide enough room for the intended layering.

slim_body.description: Sits closer through the chest and waist with limited extra room.

regular_body.description: Provides moderate room through the chest and waist while maintaining a balanced shape.

relaxed_body.description: Provides additional room through the torso for a softer and more comfortable silhouette.

oversized_body.description: Uses substantial extra width through the torso for an intentionally loose and high-volume silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Judge jacket body width together with shoulder structure, sleeve width, jacket length and layering space. Body width alone should not determine whether a jacket is oversized.

rules.name: Shirt cuff proportion guidance
rules.guideline: Cuff size and structure add visual weight at the wrist and should work with the shirt's sleeve and overall fit.

slim_cuff.description: A narrower cuff creates a subtle and streamlined finish at the wrist.

standard_cuff.description: A moderate cuff provides balanced structure and works with most everyday shirt proportions.

wide_cuff.description: A wider cuff creates stronger visual weight around the wrist and can add a more noticeable styling detail.

rules.styling_tip: Consider cuff width together with sleeve width, sleeve length, watch size and overall shirt proportion. A heavier cuff can complement a roomier sleeve without requiring the entire shirt to be oversized.

rules.name: T-shirt hem width guidance
rules.guideline: The width of the T-shirt hem influences the lower part of the upper-body silhouette and should match the garment's body width.

narrow_hem.description: A closer hem creates a more streamlined transition around the waist and hip.

regular_hem.description: A moderate hem width maintains a balanced shape through the waist and hip.

wide_hem.description: A wider hem supports additional torso volume and creates a broader relaxed silhouette.

very_wide_hem.description: A substantially wider hem supports a high-volume silhouette throughout the lower torso.

rules.styling_tip: Judge hem width together with chest width, shoulder placement, sleeve width and T-shirt length. A wide hem should connect naturally with the garment's overall silhouette.

rules.name: Trouser thigh-to-hem transition guidance
rules.guideline: How the trouser width changes from the thigh toward the hem determines whether the leg looks tapered, straight or flowing.

strong_taper.description: The leg becomes noticeably narrower from the thigh toward the hem.

gentle_taper.description: The leg narrows gradually toward the hem while retaining moderate room.

consistent_width.description: The leg maintains a relatively similar width from thigh through hem.

increasing_width.description: The leg becomes wider toward the lower portion, creating a flowing and more substantial silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Evaluate the complete transition from thigh to hem rather than judging only the hem width. The change in width should support the intended trouser silhouette.

rules.name: T-shirt sleeve opening guidance
rules.guideline: The sleeve opening affects how much room the sleeve has around the upper arm and contributes to the overall T-shirt silhouette.

narrow_opening.description: A closer sleeve opening creates a sharper and more fitted appearance around the upper arm.

regular_opening.description: Provides moderate room around the upper arm and creates a balanced everyday appearance.

wide_opening.description: Provides additional room around the upper arm and contributes to a relaxed or boxy silhouette.

very_wide_opening.description: Creates substantial space around the upper arm and supports a distinctly oversized silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Judge sleeve opening together with sleeve length, shoulder placement, body width and fabric drape. A wide sleeve opening alone does not automatically make a T-shirt oversized.

rules.name: Shirt shoulder-to-body balance guidance
rules.guideline: Shoulder placement and shirt body width should work together to create a coherent fitted, regular, relaxed or oversized silhouette.

fitted_balance.description: Natural shoulder placement combines with a relatively narrow body for a clean and structured silhouette.

regular_balance.description: Natural shoulder placement with moderate body width creates a balanced everyday silhouette.

relaxed_balance.description: Slightly more shoulder and body room creates a comfortable silhouette without extreme volume.

oversized_balance.description: Noticeably dropped shoulders combined with increased body width creates a high-volume silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Evaluate shoulder placement and body width together with sleeve width and shirt length. A single measurement should not determine the overall shirt fit.

rules.name: Jeans rise and top proportion guidance
rules.guideline: The relationship between jeans rise and top length affects where the visual waistline appears and changes the overall outfit proportion.

high_rise_short_top.description: A higher waistband combined with a shorter top creates a higher visual waistline and a clearer leg line.

high_rise_regular_top.description: A higher rise with a regular-length top creates a balanced transition between the upper and lower body.

mid_rise_regular_top.description: A mid-rise waistband with regular top length creates a natural and versatile proportion.

low_rise_longer_top.description: A lower waistband combined with a longer top creates a longer visual upper-body proportion.

rules.styling_tip: Consider jeans rise together with top length, top volume and footwear. These combinations are proportion guidelines, not fixed body-type rules.

rules.name: Jacket lapel width guidance
rules.guideline: Lapel width changes the visual weight across the chest and should work with the jacket's shoulder structure and overall proportions.

narrow_lapel.description: A narrower lapel creates a lighter and more streamlined visual effect across the chest.

medium_lapel.description: A moderate lapel width provides balanced visual weight and works across many jacket proportions.

wide_lapel.description: A wider lapel creates stronger visual weight across the chest and can complement broader jacket proportions.

rules.styling_tip: Consider lapel width together with shoulder structure, jacket body width, collar size and overall jacket proportion. Lapel width alone should not determine whether a jacket is formal or casual.

rules.name: Shirt cuff and sleeve proportion guidance
rules.guideline: The relationship between cuff size and sleeve width affects how balanced the shirt looks around the wrist and forearm.

narrow_sleeve_narrow_cuff.description: A closer sleeve with a smaller cuff creates a streamlined and structured finish.

regular_sleeve_standard_cuff.description: A moderate sleeve and cuff combination creates a balanced everyday proportion.

wide_sleeve_wider_cuff.description: A roomier sleeve paired with a more substantial cuff creates a stronger wrist-to-sleeve proportion.

rules.styling_tip: Consider cuff and sleeve proportions together with watch size and shirt body width. The wrist detail should support the overall sleeve volume rather than appear visually disconnected.

rules.name: Cargo pocket placement guidance
rules.guideline: The vertical and horizontal placement of cargo pockets affects where visual attention and volume appear on the trousers.

upper_thigh_placement.description: Pockets positioned higher on the thigh create stronger visual detail in the upper-leg area.

mid_thigh_placement.description: Pockets around the middle of the thigh provide a balanced distribution of functional detail.

lower_thigh_placement.description: Lower pocket placement shifts visual detail closer to the knee and lower leg.

balanced_side_placement.description: Consistent placement on both legs creates a more symmetrical and controlled appearance.

rules.styling_tip: Consider pocket placement together with pocket size, thigh room and overall leg width. Multiple pockets placed at different heights can create additional visual complexity.

rules.name: Hoodie ribbing and hem fit guidance
rules.guideline: The tension and width of hoodie ribbing at the hem can change how the garment falls around the waist and hip.

snug_ribbed_hem.description: A closer hem gathers the fabric slightly and creates a more defined lower edge.

moderate_ribbed_hem.description: Provides controlled gathering while allowing the hoodie body to maintain a relaxed shape.

loose_hem.description: A less restrictive hem allows the hoodie body to fall more freely over the waist and hips.

rules.styling_tip: Consider hem tension together with hoodie body width, length and fabric weight. A tight ribbed hem can change how an otherwise relaxed hoodie drapes around the torso.

rules.name: T-shirt shoulder seam placement guidance
rules.guideline: The position of the shoulder seam changes the visual structure of the upper body and contributes to the garment's overall silhouette.

on_shoulder.description: The seam sits close to the natural shoulder edge and creates a defined, structured appearance.

slightly_outside_shoulder.description: The seam extends slightly beyond the natural shoulder edge and creates a softer, relaxed appearance.

far_outside_shoulder.description: The seam sits noticeably beyond the natural shoulder edge and contributes to a strong oversized silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Evaluate shoulder seam placement together with shoulder width, body width, sleeve length and sleeve width. Seam position alone should not determine the T-shirt's fit category.

rules.name: Trouser waistband width guidance
rules.guideline: Waistband width affects the visual definition at the waist and should work with the trouser rise, belt and overall garment proportions.

narrow_waistband.description: Creates a subtle waist detail and keeps the upper edge visually lightweight.

standard_waistband.description: Provides balanced structure around the waist and works across common trouser silhouettes.

wide_waistband.description: Creates stronger visual definition at the waist and can complement trousers with greater rise or volume.

rules.styling_tip: Consider waistband width together with trouser rise, belt width and top length. A wider waistband can support a stronger waist structure but should remain proportionate to the trousers.

rules.name: Overshirt pocket proportion guidance
rules.guideline: Pocket size and placement can change the visual weight of an overshirt and should support its overall relaxed or structured silhouette.

minimal_pockets.description: Small or low-profile pockets keep the front clean and reduce visual weight.

standard_pockets.description: Moderate pockets add practical detail while maintaining balanced front proportions.

large_patch_pockets.description: Larger patch pockets add noticeable visual weight and reinforce a utility-inspired silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider pocket size and placement together with overshirt width, length and layering volume. Large pockets can make the upper body appear more substantial.

rules.name: Shorts leg opening guidance
rules.guideline: The leg opening affects how much space surrounds the thigh and influences the overall shorts silhouette.

narrow_opening.description: A closer opening creates a cleaner and more streamlined appearance around the thigh.

regular_opening.description: A moderate opening provides balanced room around the thigh and supports versatile everyday styling.

wide_opening.description: A wider opening provides more space around the thigh and creates a relaxed lower-body silhouette.

very_wide_opening.description: A substantially wide opening creates strong visual volume around the thigh.

rules.styling_tip: Judge the leg opening together with shorts length, seat fit, thigh room and footwear. Width should support the intended silhouette without restricting movement.

rules.name: Blazer sleeve and shirt cuff relationship guidance
rules.guideline: When a shirt is worn under a blazer, the visible cuff should create a deliberate transition between the two sleeves.

minimal_cuff_visibility.description: Little shirt cuff is visible beyond the blazer sleeve, creating a clean and understated transition.

moderate_cuff_visibility.description: A small amount of shirt cuff remains visible beyond the blazer sleeve, creating clear layering definition.

excessive_cuff_visibility.description: A large amount of shirt sleeve extends beyond the blazer sleeve and can make the sleeve proportions appear unbalanced.

rules.styling_tip: Consider shirt sleeve length, blazer sleeve length, cuff size and watch placement together. The visible cuff should look intentional rather than accidental.

rules.name: Hoodie sleeve-to-cuff proportion guidance
rules.guideline: The relationship between hoodie sleeve length, sleeve width and cuff tension affects how clean or relaxed the sleeves appear.

fitted_cuff.description: A closer cuff gathers the sleeve at the wrist and creates a more controlled sleeve finish.

moderate_cuff.description: A balanced cuff allows some sleeve volume while keeping the wrist area controlled.

loose_cuff.description: A less restrictive cuff allows more sleeve fabric to fall naturally around the wrist.

rules.styling_tip: Consider cuff tension together with sleeve width, sleeve length and hoodie body volume. A loose sleeve should still maintain a deliberate silhouette around the wrist.

rules.name: Trouser and top volume balance guidance
rules.guideline: The volume of the trousers and top should create a deliberate overall silhouette rather than excessive or disconnected proportions.

slim_bottom_voluminous_top.description: A narrower bottom creates contrast against a wider or oversized upper layer.

straight_bottom_regular_top.description: Balanced top and bottom volume creates a straightforward and versatile silhouette.

relaxed_bottom_relaxed_top.description: Similar moderate volume creates a comfortable and cohesive relaxed silhouette.

wide_bottom_structured_top.description: A wider bottom combined with a more controlled top creates contrast while keeping the overall silhouette defined.

wide_bottom_voluminous_top.description: High volume through both the top and bottom creates a deliberately oversized silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider top width, bottom width, garment length and footwear together. There is no single correct proportion; the goal is an intentional and comfortable silhouette.

rules.name: Jacket hem and bottom proportion guidance
rules.guideline: The relationship between jacket hem position and bottom rise affects how the upper and lower body connect visually.

cropped_jacket_high_rise_bottom.description: A shorter jacket ending near the waist works with a higher-rise bottom to create a clear waist position and longer visual leg line.

regular_jacket_mid_rise_bottom.description: A regular jacket length with a mid-rise bottom creates a balanced transition between upper and lower body.

long_jacket_relaxed_bottom.description: A longer jacket combined with a roomier bottom creates a continuous relaxed silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider jacket length together with bottom rise, bottom width and jacket volume. The hem should create an intentional transition rather than an accidental break in proportion.

rules.name: Jeans waistband and belt loop proportion guidance
rules.guideline: The waistband and belt-loop structure should work with the jeans rise, belt width and overall denim silhouette.

low_profile_waistband.description: A simpler waistband creates a clean and lightweight appearance around the waist.

standard_waistband.description: A conventional waistband provides balanced structure and works across common jeans fits.

substantial_waistband.description: A stronger waistband and larger belt-loop structure can support heavier denim and a more substantial silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider waistband structure together with jeans rise, belt width and denim weight. The waist detail should remain proportional to the overall jeans construction.

rules.name: Shirt front and back length guidance
rules.guideline: Different front and back lengths change the way a shirt sits over trousers and affects the overall layered proportion.

even_length.description: Similar front and back lengths create a clean and uniform hem.

slightly_longer_back.description: A modestly extended back provides additional coverage while maintaining a controlled front proportion.

significantly_longer_back.description: A noticeably extended back creates stronger asymmetry and additional rear coverage.

rules.styling_tip: Consider front-to-back length together with shirt width, hem shape, trouser rise and whether the shirt is tucked. A longer back should look intentional rather than simply oversized.

rules.name: T-shirt hem shape guidance
rules.guideline: The shape of the T-shirt hem affects how the garment ends around the waist and hip and can change the overall silhouette.

straight_hem.description: A level hem creates a clean and consistent horizontal line across the lower edge.

slightly_curved_hem.description: A gentle curve creates a softer transition around the waist and hip.

deep_curved_hem.description: A stronger curve creates a more noticeable difference between the front and side hem positions.

rules.styling_tip: Consider hem shape together with T-shirt length, body width and bottom rise. The hem should support the intended silhouette rather than add unnecessary visual complexity.

rules.name: Trouser pleat direction and placement guidance
rules.guideline: Pleat direction and placement influence how fabric opens around the waist and upper thigh and should support the trouser's intended silhouette.

forward_pleat.description: The pleat opens toward the front and creates a softer, more traditional appearance around the upper thigh.

reverse_pleat.description: The pleat opens toward the side and creates a cleaner front appearance while still allowing additional upper-thigh room.

centered_pleat.description: A clearly positioned central pleat creates a defined vertical detail through the front of the trouser.

rules.styling_tip: Consider pleat direction and placement together with rise, thigh room, leg width and fabric drape. Pleat structure should complement the trouser silhouette rather than compete with it.

rules.name: Kurta neckline and collar proportion guidance
rules.guideline: The neckline and collar structure influence the visual framing of the upper body and should match the kurta's overall silhouette.

band_collar.description: A short standing collar creates a clean and structured neckline.

mandarin_collar.description: A structured upright collar creates a refined ethnic appearance around the neck.

round_neck.description: A simple rounded neckline creates a softer and more casual upper-body appearance.

open_neckline.description: An open neckline creates more visible space around the neck and gives a relaxed appearance.

rules.styling_tip: Consider neckline structure together with kurta width, sleeve volume, collar height and overall length. A stronger collar can add structure to an otherwise relaxed kurta.

rules.name: Shorts rise and top proportion guidance
rules.guideline: Shorts rise changes where the waistband sits and affects how the top and lower body connect visually.

high_rise_short_top.description: A higher waistband with a shorter top creates a higher visual waistline and a clearer leg line.

high_rise_regular_top.description: A higher rise with regular top length creates a balanced transition between the upper and lower body.

mid_rise_regular_top.description: A mid-rise waistband with regular top length creates a natural and versatile proportion.

low_rise_longer_top.description: A lower waistband combined with a longer top creates a longer visual upper-body proportion.

rules.styling_tip: Consider shorts rise together with top length, top volume and shorts length. These are proportion guidelines, not fixed body-type rules.

rules.name: Shirt placket length guidance
rules.guideline: The length of the shirt opening affects how much visual space is created around the chest and neckline.

short_placket.description: A shorter opening keeps the neckline relatively compact and creates a cleaner upper-body appearance.

standard_placket.description: A conventional opening creates balanced visual structure through the front of the shirt.

long_placket.description: A longer opening creates a more noticeable vertical line and a more open front appearance.

rules.styling_tip: Consider placket length together with collar size, shirt width, neckline opening and overall garment length. A longer opening can add visual depth without changing the shirt's actual fit.

rules.name: Armhole depth guidance
rules.guideline: Armhole depth affects how freely a garment moves around the shoulders and underarm and contributes to the overall fit.

high_armhole.description: A higher armhole sits closer to the underarm and provides a more controlled connection between the sleeve and torso.

medium_armhole.description: A moderate armhole provides a balance between movement and a controlled garment shape.

low_armhole.description: A deeper armhole creates more space around the underarm and contributes to a relaxed garment structure.

rules.styling_tip: Consider armhole depth together with sleeve width, shoulder construction and garment ease. A deeper armhole can increase perceived looseness even when the garment body width is moderate.

rules.name: Trouser outseam and side seam alignment guidance
rules.guideline: The position and alignment of the trouser side seam can affect how evenly the leg silhouette appears from the front and side.

centered_side_seam.description: The side seam follows the natural side of the leg and creates a balanced visual leg line.

slightly_forward_seam.description: A seam positioned slightly toward the front can change the visible shape of the trouser leg and create a more designed appearance.

prominent_design_seam.description: A deliberately visible seam becomes part of the garment design and adds structural detail to the leg.

rules.styling_tip: Evaluate seam position together with leg shape, crease, hem width and pocket placement. The seam should support the intended silhouette rather than create unintended visual imbalance.

rules.name: Jeans back yoke and seat shape guidance
rules.guideline: The back yoke and seat construction influence how jeans follow the upper back of the hips and contribute to the rear silhouette.

shallow_yoke.description: A shallower yoke creates a relatively subtle transition between the waistband and seat area.

standard_yoke.description: A conventional yoke provides balanced shaping between the waistband and seat.

deep_yoke.description: A deeper yoke creates more noticeable shaping through the upper back of the jeans.

contoured_seat.description: A shaped seat follows the body's natural curves more closely and creates a more defined rear silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Judge the yoke and seat shape together with the waistband, rise, thigh room and overall leg shape. The construction should provide comfortable movement without excessive pulling or sagging.

rules.name: Jacket vent structure guidance
rules.guideline: The rear vent structure affects how a jacket falls around the hips and changes the movement and visual shape of the back.

no_vent.description: A closed back creates a clean uninterrupted rear silhouette with less visible opening.

single_vent.description: A central rear opening allows easier movement while maintaining a clean tailored appearance.

double_vent.description: Two rear openings provide additional movement and create a more flexible tailored silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider vent structure together with jacket length, width and overall fit. The vent should allow the jacket to fall naturally without pulling or bunching around the hips.

rules.name: Kurta side slit length guidance
rules.guideline: The length of side slits affects how freely the kurta moves and changes the visual connection between the kurta and bottom.

short_slit.description: A shorter side opening keeps more of the lower kurta connected and creates a relatively structured appearance.

medium_slit.description: A moderate side opening provides balanced movement while maintaining a controlled silhouette.

long_slit.description: A longer side opening allows greater movement and creates a more flowing contemporary silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider slit length together with kurta length, width and bottom style. Longer slits can reveal more of the bottom, so the overall combination should remain visually balanced.

rules.name: Shirt back yoke guidance
rules.guideline: The back yoke construction affects how a shirt sits across the shoulders and upper back and can influence movement and structure.

no_yoke.description: A simpler back construction creates a clean uninterrupted appearance across the upper back.

standard_yoke.description: A conventional shoulder yoke provides structure across the upper back and supports comfortable movement.

split_yoke.description: A divided yoke construction provides additional shaping and is commonly used in structured or heritage-inspired shirts.

rules.styling_tip: Consider the back yoke together with shoulder placement, back width and fabric structure. Yoke construction affects how the shirt sits but does not by itself determine the shirt's fit category.

rules.name: Hoodie body length guidance
rules.guideline: Hoodie body length affects the upper-to-lower body proportion and should work with the bottom rise and overall hoodie volume.

cropped_hoodie.description: Ends around the waist or upper hip and creates a shorter upper-body proportion.

regular_length_hoodie.description: Provides balanced coverage around the hip and works across common everyday silhouettes.

long_hoodie.description: Extends further over the hip and creates a longer, more relaxed upper-body silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider hoodie length together with body width, shoulder drop, sleeve volume and bottom rise. Longer hoodies can create extra visual bulk when combined with high-volume bottoms.

rules.name: Jacket front length guidance
rules.guideline: The front length of a jacket affects how the garment frames the torso and connects visually with the bottom.

short_front_length.description: Ends higher around the waist or upper hip and creates a shorter, more contemporary torso proportion.

regular_front_length.description: Ends around the hip and creates a balanced transition between the jacket and bottom.

long_front_length.description: Extends further over the hip and creates a longer, more substantial upper-body silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider jacket front length together with jacket hem shape, bottom rise, jacket volume and inner-layer length. The front should create a deliberate proportion without excessive overlap.

rules.name: Shorts seat fit guidance
rules.guideline: The seat fit determines how comfortably shorts follow the hips and upper rear area while maintaining the intended silhouette.

close_seat.description: The fabric follows the seat closely with limited extra room.
close_seat.visual_effect: Creates a cleaner and more defined appearance.

balanced_seat.description: Provides moderate room through the seat for comfortable movement without excessive fabric.
balanced_seat.visual_effect: Creates a natural and versatile silhouette.

relaxed_seat.description: Provides additional room through the seat and supports a looser lower-body silhouette.
relaxed_seat.visual_effect: Creates a comfortable and relaxed appearance.

rules.styling_tip: Judge seat fit together with shorts rise, thigh room, leg opening and overall volume. Extra room should support movement without creating unintended sagging.

rules.name: Shirt side vent length guidance
rules.guideline: Side vents change how a shirt falls around the hips and can improve movement while affecting the visible side silhouette.

no_side_vent.description: A closed side seam creates a continuous and more structured side silhouette.

short_side_vent.description: A small side opening provides some movement while keeping the shirt visually controlled.

long_side_vent.description: A longer side opening allows greater movement and creates a more relaxed side silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider side vent length together with shirt body length, hem shape, width and whether the shirt is tucked. Longer vents can work well with relaxed silhouettes but should not create unnecessary side bulk.

rules.name: Jacket vent length guidance
rules.guideline: The length of a jacket's rear vent affects movement and how the jacket falls around the hips.

short_vent.description: A shorter opening provides limited additional movement while keeping the rear silhouette relatively compact.

standard_vent.description: A moderate opening provides balanced movement and maintains a controlled rear silhouette.

long_vent.description: A longer opening allows greater movement and creates a more noticeable split through the lower back.

rules.styling_tip: Consider vent length together with jacket length, width and bottom silhouette. The vent should allow natural movement without creating unnecessary separation or fabric bunching.

rules.name: Cargo trouser cuff adjustment guidance
rules.guideline: The way cargo trouser cuffs are finished can change the lower-leg silhouette and how the trousers interact with footwear.

open_cuff.description: The hem remains open and falls naturally around the footwear.

elastic_cuff.description: An elasticated hem gathers the fabric around the ankle and creates a more defined lower-leg finish.

adjustable_cuff.description: A drawcord or fastening allows the hem width to be changed according to the desired silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider cuff construction together with cargo leg width, trouser length and footwear. A gathered cuff can make a wide trouser leg appear more concentrated around the ankle.

rules.name: Knitwear sleeve length guidance
rules.guideline: Knitwear sleeve length affects the visual balance of the arms and should account for knit thickness, cuff structure and layering.

wrist_length.description: Ends around the wrist and creates a clean, controlled sleeve proportion.
