slightly_extended.description: Extends slightly beyond the wrist and creates a softer, relaxed sleeve appearance.

long_sleeve.description: Extends noticeably beyond the wrist and contributes to a deliberately relaxed or oversized silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider sleeve length together with knit thickness, cuff structure, shoulder placement and overall garment volume. Longer sleeves should look intentional rather than simply oversized.

rules.name: Jeans front rise shape guidance
rules.guideline: The shape and curvature of the front rise affect how jeans sit between the waistband and crotch and influence comfort and overall fit.

shallow_front_rise_curve.description: A relatively shallow curve creates a closer and more streamlined front appearance.

standard_front_rise_curve.description: A balanced curve provides a natural transition from the waistband through the front rise.

deeper_front_rise_curve.description: A deeper curve provides additional space through the front rise and supports a more relaxed construction.

rules.styling_tip: Consider the front rise shape together with waistband position, seat fit, thigh room and denim stretch. The front rise should provide comfortable movement without excessive pulling or fabric bunching.

rules.name: Trouser fabric weight guidance
rules.guideline: Fabric weight affects how trousers hold their shape, drape around the legs and contribute to the overall silhouette.

lightweight.description: Lighter fabric moves easily and creates a softer, more fluid appearance.

medium_weight.description: Moderate fabric weight provides a balance between structure and movement.

heavyweight.description: Heavier fabric holds more structure and adds visual substance to the lower body.

rules.styling_tip: Consider fabric weight together with trouser fit, leg shape and footwear. Heavy fabric can make a relaxed silhouette appear more substantial, while lightweight fabric can create more movement.

rules.name: Shirt fabric weight guidance
rules.guideline: Shirt fabric weight affects structure, drape and how much visual volume the garment creates.

lightweight.description: Light fabric falls more freely and creates a softer, breathable appearance.

medium_weight.description: Moderate fabric weight provides a balance between structure and natural movement.

heavyweight.description: Heavier fabric holds more shape and adds visual substance to the upper body.

rules.styling_tip: Consider fabric weight together with shirt width, shoulder placement and drape. A heavyweight shirt can appear more structured or substantial even when its measured fit is relaxed.

rules.name: Jacket fabric weight guidance
rules.guideline: Jacket fabric weight affects structure, drape, warmth and the visual substance of the outer layer.

lightweight.description: Lighter fabric creates easier movement and a less substantial outer-layer silhouette.

medium_weight.description: Moderate fabric weight balances structure, movement and everyday versatility.

heavyweight.description: Heavier fabric provides greater structure and adds noticeable visual and physical substance.

rules.styling_tip: Consider jacket fabric weight together with jacket fit, layering space and bottom volume. A heavier jacket can increase the perceived visual weight of the entire outfit.

rules.name: Shorts fabric weight guidance
rules.guideline: Shorts fabric weight affects how the garment hangs, moves and contributes to the visual weight of the lower body.

lightweight.description: Light fabric moves easily and creates a softer, breathable appearance.

medium_weight.description: Moderate fabric weight provides balanced structure and comfortable everyday movement.

heavyweight.description: Heavier fabric holds more shape and creates a more substantial lower-body appearance.

rules.styling_tip: Consider fabric weight together with shorts fit, length and leg opening. Heavier fabric can make wide shorts appear more substantial, while lightweight fabric creates more movement.

rules.name: Trouser waistband height guidance
rules.guideline: The visible height and construction of the waistband can affect how the waist area connects with the top.

low_profile_waistband.description: A slimmer waistband creates a subtle transition between the top and trousers.

standard_waistband.description: A conventional waistband provides balanced structure around the waist.

extended_waistband.description: A taller waistband creates a stronger visual detail around the waist and can emphasize tailored construction.

rules.styling_tip: Consider waistband height together with rise, belt width, top length and trouser construction. The waistband should remain proportional to the rest of the garment.

rules.name: Shirt cuff structure guidance
rules.guideline: Cuff construction affects how the shirt sleeve finishes around the wrist and contributes to the overall sleeve appearance.

button_cuff.description: A standard buttoned cuff creates a clean and controlled sleeve finish.

french_cuff.description: A folded cuff creates a more structured and formal sleeve finish.

barrel_cuff.description: A structured cuff with multiple adjustment positions allows the sleeve opening to be controlled around the wrist.

convertible_cuff.description: A flexible cuff can be worn with buttons or cufflinks depending on the styling.

rules.styling_tip: Consider cuff structure together with sleeve length, sleeve width and watch placement. The cuff should sit comfortably around the wrist without excessive looseness or restriction.

rules.name: Trouser cuff style guidance
rules.guideline: The finishing style at the trouser hem can change the visual character of the lower leg and footwear connection.

plain_hem.description: A clean unfinished-looking hem creates a simple and streamlined lower-leg appearance.

turn_up_cuff.description: A folded hem adds a visible horizontal detail and slightly increases visual weight around the ankle.

stitched_cuff.description: A permanently constructed folded hem creates a defined and structured finish.

rules.styling_tip: Consider cuff style together with trouser width, fabric weight and footwear. A heavier cuff can add visual weight at the ankle, so the lower-leg silhouette should remain balanced.

rules.name: T-shirt shoulder seam position guidance
rules.guideline: The position of the shoulder seam affects how the T-shirt frames the shoulders and contributes to the perceived garment structure.

at_shoulder_edge.description: The seam sits close to the natural shoulder edge and creates a defined upper-body outline.

slightly_beyond_shoulder.description: The seam extends modestly beyond the natural shoulder edge and creates a softer, relaxed outline.

far_beyond_shoulder.description: The seam extends noticeably beyond the natural shoulder edge and creates a stronger dropped-shoulder effect.

rules.styling_tip: Judge shoulder seam position together with garment width, sleeve volume and body length. Seam position should be evaluated as part of the complete T-shirt construction.

rules.name: Jacket lapel roll guidance
rules.guideline: The lapel roll describes how the lapel folds from the collar toward the jacket front and affects the visual structure of the chest.

soft_roll.description: A softer fold creates a relaxed and natural transition from the collar into the jacket front.

defined_roll.description: A clear fold creates a structured and polished transition across the upper chest.

strong_roll.description: A pronounced fold creates a distinctive chest structure and adds stronger visual character.

rules.styling_tip: Consider lapel roll together with collar construction, jacket structure and fabric behaviour. The roll should complement the jacket's intended level of structure rather than appear disconnected from it.

rules.name: Shirt cuff opening guidance
rules.guideline: The cuff opening determines how closely the sleeve finishes around the wrist and affects comfort and sleeve structure.

close_cuff_opening.description: A closer opening keeps the sleeve end controlled around the wrist.

standard_cuff_opening.description: A moderate opening provides balanced wrist movement and a versatile sleeve finish.

wide_cuff_opening.description: A wider opening allows more space around the wrist and creates a more relaxed sleeve finish.

rules.styling_tip: Consider cuff opening together with sleeve width, cuff construction and wrist accessories. The opening should allow comfortable movement without excessive looseness.

rules.name: Jeans fly construction guidance
rules.guideline: The front fly construction affects the visual continuity of the jeans front and should work with the overall denim design.

zip_fly.description: A zipper closure creates a clean and straightforward front with minimal visible hardware.

button_fly.description: Multiple buttons create a visible vertical closure detail and add a traditional denim character.

concealed_fly.description: The closure is visually minimized to maintain a cleaner uninterrupted front appearance.

rules.styling_tip: Fly construction is primarily a garment-design detail rather than a fit rule. Consider it alongside the jeans' overall design, rise and intended aesthetic.

rules.name: Jeans waistband curvature guidance
rules.guideline: The curvature of the jeans waistband affects how evenly it follows the waist and can influence comfort and the appearance of the waist area.

straight_waistband.description: A relatively straight waistband provides a simple and structured waist shape.

contoured_waistband.description: A shaped waistband follows the body's waist curve more closely and can provide a more secure feel.

extended_contour.description: A more pronounced curved construction provides additional shaping around the waist while maintaining a secure fit.

rules.styling_tip: Consider waistband curvature together with rise, seat fit and denim stretch. The waistband should sit securely without excessive gaping, pinching or pulling.

rules.name: Jacket collar stand guidance
rules.guideline: The collar stand affects how the jacket collar sits away from the neck and contributes to the structure around the upper back and neckline.

low_collar_stand.description: A lower collar stand keeps the collar closer to the neckline and creates a softer appearance.

medium_collar_stand.description: A moderate stand provides balanced structure around the neck.

high_collar_stand.description: A higher stand creates a stronger raised neckline and adds visual structure around the upper body.

rules.styling_tip: Consider collar stand together with collar shape, jacket shoulder structure and fabric weight. A higher stand can make the upper neckline appear more substantial.

rules.name: Shirt yoke width guidance
rules.guideline: The width of a shirt's back yoke affects how the shoulder area transitions into the upper back and contributes to the garment's structure.

narrow_yoke.description: A narrower yoke creates a more subtle structural transition across the upper back.

standard_yoke.description: A conventional yoke width provides balanced coverage across the shoulders and upper back.

wide_yoke.description: A wider yoke creates a stronger structural panel across the upper back.

rules.styling_tip: Consider yoke width together with shoulder placement, back width and fabric structure. Yoke width is a construction detail and should not be used alone to classify a shirt's fit.

rules.name: Jacket hem shape guidance
rules.guideline: The shape of a jacket hem affects how the garment ends around the lower torso and can change the visual character of the outer layer.

straight_hem.description: A level hem creates a clean horizontal finish and a controlled lower edge.

rounded_hem.description: A curved hem creates a softer transition around the sides and lower torso.

split_hem.description: A hem with deliberate openings creates additional movement and separates the lower edge visually.

rules.styling_tip: Consider hem shape together with jacket length, width, vent construction and bottom rise. The hem should support the intended silhouette rather than create unnecessary visual breaks.

rules.name: T-shirt side seam shape guidance
rules.guideline: The side seam shape affects how the T-shirt falls from the underarm toward the hem and contributes to the overall body silhouette.

straight_side_seam.description: The seam runs relatively straight from the underarm to the hem and creates a clean consistent body shape.

slightly_shaped_side_seam.description: The seam gently follows the torso before reaching the hem and creates a more defined body outline.

tapered_side_seam.description: The body gradually narrows toward the hem and creates a more fitted lower-torso appearance.

expanded_side_seam.description: The body becomes wider toward the lower section and creates additional volume around the hem.

rules.styling_tip: Consider side seam shape together with body width, hem shape and garment length. The complete torso profile should look intentional rather than relying on one seam characteristic.

rules.name: Trouser back pocket placement guidance
rules.guideline: The position and spacing of rear trouser pockets can affect the visual balance of the back of the garment.

standard_placement.description: Pockets positioned in a conventional location create a balanced and familiar rear appearance.

higher_placement.description: Higher rear pockets create a higher visual detail point on the back of the trousers.

lower_placement.description: Lower rear pockets place more visual detail toward the seat and upper-leg area.

minimal_or_no_back_pockets.description: Reducing or removing rear pocket details creates a cleaner uninterrupted back appearance.

rules.styling_tip: Consider rear pocket placement together with seat fit, waistband structure and overall trouser design. Pocket position should support the garment's visual balance rather than compensate for poor fit.

rules.name: Jeans coin pocket guidance
rules.guideline: The presence and size of the coin pocket adds a small functional detail to the front pocket area without defining the overall jeans fit.

minimal_coin_pocket.description: A small, low-profile coin pocket keeps the front pocket area visually clean.

standard_coin_pocket.description: A conventional coin pocket adds familiar denim detailing while maintaining balanced front proportions.

prominent_coin_pocket.description: A more visible coin pocket adds stronger utility or workwear-inspired detailing.

rules.styling_tip: Coin pocket design is mainly a denim construction detail. Consider it together with the other pocket details and overall jeans aesthetic rather than using it to judge fit.

rules.name: Shirt button spacing guidance
rules.guideline: Button spacing affects the visual rhythm of the shirt front and should match the garment's structure and intended styling.

close_spacing.description: Buttons positioned closer together create a more continuous and structured front appearance.

standard_spacing.description: Balanced spacing creates a conventional and versatile shirt front.

wide_spacing.description: Greater spacing creates more open visual rhythm and can give the shirt a relaxed or contemporary character.

rules.styling_tip: Consider button spacing together with placket width, collar structure and shirt body proportions. Spacing is a design detail and does not independently determine shirt fit.

rules.name: Trouser waistband closure guidance
rules.guideline: The waistband closure affects how securely trousers sit at the waist and contributes to the front construction of the garment.

hook_and_bar.description: A hook-and-bar closure creates a clean, concealed fastening commonly used in tailored trousers.

button_closure.description: A visible or concealed button provides a simple fastening and adds a traditional construction detail.

extended_tab_closure.description: An extended waistband tab creates a structured front and can reduce the need for a prominent belt.

rules.styling_tip: Consider waistband closure together with rise, waistband structure and belt use. The closure should keep the trousers secure without creating unnecessary bulk at the waist.

rules.name: T-shirt sleeve hem finish guidance
rules.guideline: The sleeve hem finish affects how the sleeve edge holds its shape and contributes to the overall arm silhouette.

clean_turned_hem.description: A simple folded and stitched edge creates a clean, controlled sleeve finish.

reinforced_hem.description: A stronger sleeve edge maintains more structure and resists losing its shape.

raw_edge.description: An unfinished-looking edge creates a deliberately casual and slightly rugged appearance.

rules.styling_tip: Consider sleeve hem finish together with sleeve width, fabric weight and garment construction. The finish should support the intended aesthetic without making the sleeve edge look accidental.

rules.name: Hoodie ribbed hem tension guidance
rules.guideline: The tension and structure of the hoodie hem affect how the garment sits around the waist and lower torso.

firm_hem.description: A tighter ribbed hem gathers the lower edge and creates a more defined finish around the waist.

moderate_hem.description: A balanced hem provides controlled shaping without strongly gathering the hoodie body.

loose_hem.description: A less restrictive hem allows the hoodie body to fall more freely and creates a relaxed lower silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider hem tension together with hoodie body width, length and fabric weight. A firm hem can visually gather a wide hoodie, while a loose hem allows greater drape.

rules.name: Shirt back pleat structure guidance
rules.guideline: Back pleat construction affects movement, back width perception and the overall silhouette of a shirt.

no_pleat.description: A clean back without pleats creates a more streamlined and controlled appearance.

box_pleat.description: A center box pleat adds controlled back ease and creates a subtle vertical structure.

side_pleats.description: Pleats placed near the shoulder blades distribute extra movement space while maintaining a relatively clean center back.

rules.styling_tip: Consider back pleat structure together with shirt body width, back yoke and overall fit. More back ease can make a shirt feel more relaxed without requiring a wider front.

rules.name: Sweatshirt ribbed hem structure guidance
rules.guideline: The structure and tension of a sweatshirt hem affect how the garment falls and how the lower torso is visually framed.

firm_ribbed_hem.description: A structured ribbed hem gathers the lower edge slightly and creates a defined finish around the waist.

moderate_ribbed_hem.description: A moderately structured hem gives controlled shaping while allowing the sweatshirt body to fall naturally.

relaxed_hem.description: A softer and less restrictive hem allows the sweatshirt to fall more freely for a relaxed silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider hem structure together with sweatshirt body width, length and fabric thickness. A structured hem creates more definition, while a relaxed hem supports a freer silhouette.

rules.name: Knitwear hem finish guidance
rules.guideline: The hem finish of knitwear affects how the lower edge sits and contributes to the overall drape and silhouette.

ribbed_hem.description: A ribbed hem gives the lower edge more structure and can create a controlled finish around the torso.

straight_hem.description: A straight hem allows the knitwear to fall more evenly and creates a clean uninterrupted lower edge.

curved_hem.description: A curved hem creates variation in front and back length and adds visual movement to the lower silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider hem finish together with knit thickness, garment length and fit. A structured hem works well when the rest of the silhouette is controlled, while a freer hem suits relaxed layering.

rules.name: Jacket lining ease guidance
rules.guideline: The amount of ease in a jacket lining affects movement, comfort and how smoothly the outer fabric sits during wear.

low_lining_ease.description: A closer lining fit creates a more controlled feel but allows less room for movement.

moderate_lining_ease.description: Balanced lining ease provides comfortable movement while helping the jacket maintain its intended outer shape.

high_lining_ease.description: More lining ease allows greater movement and supports a relaxed feel inside the jacket.

rules.styling_tip: Consider lining ease together with outer fabric structure, jacket width and intended layering. Excess lining tension can restrict movement, while excessive looseness can create unwanted bunching.

rules.name: Blazer chest structure guidance
rules.guideline: The amount of chest structure in a blazer affects how defined the upper torso appears and how the jacket holds its shape.

structured_chest.description: A more structured chest creates a defined and architectural upper-torso shape.

moderate_chest_structure.description: Moderate structure provides shape while maintaining a natural and comfortable appearance.

soft_chest.description: A softer chest construction follows the body more naturally and creates a relaxed jacket appearance.

rules.styling_tip: Consider chest structure together with shoulder structure, jacket length and fabric weight. Strong chest structure suits a defined tailored silhouette, while softer construction works well for relaxed outfits.

rules.name: Kurta side seam shape guidance
rules.guideline: The shape of the kurta side seam affects how the garment falls from the underarm toward the hem and influences the overall silhouette.

straight_side_seam.description: A relatively straight side seam creates a clean vertical silhouette with limited shaping through the torso.

slightly_shaped_side_seam.description: A gently shaped side seam follows the torso more closely while maintaining comfortable ease.

relaxed_side_seam.description: A freer side seam provides more room through the torso and creates a visibly relaxed silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider side seam shape together with kurta width, side slit length and fabric drape. The goal is a consistent silhouette rather than maximum shaping.

rules.name: Jacket lining length guidance
rules.guideline: The lining should support the jacket's movement and construction without pulling or becoming noticeably shorter than the outer garment.

appropriate_length.description: A properly proportioned lining follows the jacket body closely while allowing normal movement and maintaining a clean interior.

slightly_shorter_lining.description: A lining that finishes slightly above the outer hem can allow controlled movement and reduce unnecessary tension at the bottom.

insufficient_length.description: A lining that is noticeably too short can pull upward during movement and interfere with the way the jacket hangs.

rules.styling_tip: When assessing a jacket, check lining length together with outer hem length, lining ease and fabric movement. The lining should not restrict the outer garment.

rules.name: Sweatshirt sleeve cuff tension guidance
rules.guideline: The tension of a sweatshirt sleeve cuff affects how the sleeve gathers at the wrist and changes the visual shape of the sleeve.

firm_cuff.description: A firmer cuff gathers the sleeve more noticeably at the wrist and creates a defined sleeve finish.

moderate_cuff.description: A moderately fitted cuff creates controlled gathering while allowing the sleeve to maintain a natural shape.

loose_cuff.description: A looser cuff allows the sleeve to fall more freely and creates a softer, relaxed finish around the wrist.

rules.styling_tip: Consider cuff tension together with sleeve width, sleeve length and fabric thickness. A wider sleeve with a firm cuff creates stronger gathering, while a loose cuff supports a freer silhouette.

rules.name: Jacket lining vent alignment guidance
rules.guideline: The lining should accommodate the jacket's back vent construction so the outer vent can open and move naturally.

single_vent_alignment.description: The lining should be positioned to allow the center back vent to open without pulling or becoming exposed unnecessarily.

double_vent_alignment.description: The lining should allow both side vents to move independently without restricting the jacket's outer back panels.

clean_vent_clearance.description: Adequate clearance around the vent prevents the lining from bunching or interfering when the wearer sits or moves.

rules.styling_tip: Check lining alignment together with the jacket's vent structure and lining ease. The lining should support movement without changing the intended outer silhouette.

rules.name: Sweatshirt neck rib structure guidance
rules.guideline: The structure and opening of a sweatshirt neck rib affect how the neckline sits against the upper chest and neck.

firm_neck_rib.description: A firm rib keeps the neckline defined and close to the neck, creating a cleaner upper-body finish.

moderate_neck_rib.description: A moderately structured rib provides a balanced neckline with comfortable movement and controlled shape.

relaxed_neck_rib.description: A softer and more relaxed rib creates a slightly wider, less restrictive neckline and a laid-back appearance.

rules.styling_tip: Consider neck rib structure together with sweatshirt fit, shoulder width and fabric thickness. The neckline should remain proportionate to the overall garment volume.

rules.name: Blazer lapel width guidance
rules.guideline: Lapel width affects the visual balance of the blazer's chest area and should remain proportionate to the jacket and wearer.

narrow_lapel.description: A narrower lapel creates a lighter and more streamlined visual effect across the chest.

medium_lapel.description: A medium-width lapel provides a balanced proportion and works across a wide range of jacket silhouettes.

wide_lapel.description: A wider lapel creates stronger visual presence across the chest and gives the blazer a more traditional or statement appearance.

rules.styling_tip: Consider lapel width together with shoulder width, chest structure and jacket proportions. The lapel should visually belong to the overall scale of the blazer.

rules.name: Blazer lapel notch position guidance
rules.guideline: The position of the lapel notch affects the visual height and balance of the blazer's upper chest.

high_notch.description: A higher notch creates a stronger upward visual line through the chest and lapel.

medium_notch.description: A moderate notch position creates balanced proportions between the collar, lapel and chest.

low_notch.description: A lower notch creates a deeper visual opening across the upper chest and gives the blazer a more traditional appearance.

rules.styling_tip: Consider notch position together with lapel width, collar proportion and jacket buttoning. These elements should create one consistent visual balance.

rules.name: Blazer button stance guidance
rules.guideline: The vertical position of a blazer's main fastening affects the visual division between the chest and lower torso.

high_button_stance.description: A higher fastening position creates a shorter visual opening and keeps more of the chest covered.

medium_button_stance.description: A moderate fastening position creates balanced proportions between the lapel opening, chest and lower jacket.

low_button_stance.description: A lower fastening position creates a deeper jacket opening and a longer visual chest-to-waist line.

rules.styling_tip: Consider button stance together with lapel width, notch position and jacket length. These elements work together to determine the blazer's overall visual proportion.

rules.name: Blazer front overlap guidance
rules.guideline: The amount of fabric overlap at the blazer front affects closure coverage and the visual balance of the jacket when fastened.

minimal_overlap.description: A smaller front overlap creates a cleaner and more open-looking jacket closure.

balanced_overlap.description: A moderate overlap provides secure closure while maintaining balanced proportions across the front.

generous_overlap.description: A deeper overlap provides greater front coverage and creates a more substantial appearance when the blazer is closed.

rules.styling_tip: Consider front overlap together with jacket width, button stance and lapel opening. The closure should sit smoothly without excessive pulling or loose fabric.

rules.name: Shirt back pleat depth guidance
rules.guideline: The depth of a back pleat controls how much additional fabric is available for movement and changes the back silhouette.

shallow_pleat.description: A shallow pleat adds limited extra fabric while keeping the back relatively clean and controlled.

medium_pleat.description: A medium-depth pleat provides additional movement ease while maintaining a balanced back appearance.

deep_pleat.description: A deeper pleat provides more fabric expansion during movement and creates a noticeably relaxed back structure.

rules.styling_tip: Consider pleat depth together with back pleat structure, shirt body width and fabric drape. More pleat depth should support movement without creating unnecessary bulk.

rules.name: Jacket sleeve pitch guidance
rules.guideline: Sleeve pitch describes the angle at which a jacket sleeve hangs from the shoulder and affects how naturally the sleeve follows the arm.

forward_pitch.description: A forward-angled sleeve follows a naturally forward arm position and can reduce twisting when the wearer stands or moves.

neutral_pitch.description: A neutral sleeve angle creates a balanced sleeve position suited to a relatively upright arm posture.

backward_pitch.description: A backward-angled sleeve positions the sleeve further behind the torso and may suit specific posture or garment constructions.

rules.styling_tip: Consider sleeve pitch together with shoulder position, armhole depth and sleeve length. Incorrect pitch can cause diagonal wrinkles or sleeve twisting even when the sleeve length is correct.

rules.name: Blazer lapel roll guidance
rules.guideline: The lapel roll describes how the lapel curves from the collar toward the chest and affects the visual softness and structure of a blazer.

flat_lapel_roll.description: A flatter lapel creates a cleaner, more controlled front appearance with less visible curvature.

natural_lapel_roll.description: A natural roll creates a smooth curved transition from the collar to the chest and gives the jacket a balanced appearance.

pronounced_lapel_roll.description: A stronger roll creates more visible curvature and gives the blazer a softer, more traditional tailoring character.

rules.styling_tip: Consider lapel roll together with lapel width, notch position and chest structure. These details should work together rather than creating competing visual lines.

rules.name: Trouser crease depth guidance
rules.guideline: The depth and visibility of a trouser crease affect the sharpness and structure of the front leg.

sharp_crease.description: A clearly defined crease creates a structured vertical line and gives the trousers a sharper appearance.

soft_crease.description: A softer crease provides some vertical structure while keeping the trousers more relaxed in appearance.

minimal_crease.description: A subtle or barely visible crease creates a more casual appearance with less visual structure through the front leg.

rules.styling_tip: Consider crease depth together with trouser fabric, leg width, pleat structure and overall formality. A sharper crease generally suits cleaner, structured silhouettes.

rules.name: Trouser crease continuity guidance
rules.guideline: A trouser crease should visually continue from the upper leg toward the hem to maintain a clean vertical line.

continuous_crease.description: A crease that remains visually aligned through the leg creates a clean and elongated vertical structure.

slightly_broken_crease.description: A minor interruption caused by movement or natural fabric behavior can still maintain a relaxed but structured appearance.

misaligned_crease.description: A crease that shifts noticeably across the leg can create visual irregularity and make the trouser shape appear less controlled.

rules.styling_tip: Check crease continuity together with leg shape, trouser break and side-seam alignment. The crease should follow the intended leg line rather than twist around the leg.

rules.name: Trouser belt loop spacing guidance
rules.guideline: The spacing and distribution of belt loops affect how evenly the waistband supports a belt and how clean the waist area appears.

even_spacing.description: Evenly distributed belt loops provide balanced support and maintain a clean appearance around the waistband.

front_balanced_spacing.description: Keeping the front loops proportionally positioned around the fastening area helps the belt sit evenly across the waist.

insufficient_spacing.description: Poorly distributed loops can cause uneven belt support and create unnecessary bunching around the waistband.

rules.styling_tip: Consider belt loop spacing together with waistband width, belt width and trouser closure. The belt should sit securely without pulling the waistband out of shape.

rules.name: Shirt cuff width guidance
rules.guideline: The width of a shirt cuff affects how substantial the wrist area looks and how the sleeve transitions into the hand.

narrow_cuff.description: A narrower cuff creates a lighter and more streamlined finish around the wrist.

standard_cuff.description: A standard-width cuff provides balanced proportions between the sleeve and wrist.

wide_cuff.description: A wider cuff creates a stronger visual presence around the wrist and can complement broader shirt proportions.

rules.styling_tip: Consider cuff width together with sleeve width, shirt fit and watch size. The cuff should remain proportionate to the overall sleeve and wrist area.

rules.name: Trouser side seam position guidance
rules.guideline: The position of the trouser side seam affects how the outer leg line appears and can influence the visual balance of the trousers.

centered_side_seam.description: A correctly positioned side seam follows the natural outer leg line and creates a balanced trouser silhouette.

slightly_forward_seam.description: A seam positioned slightly toward the front can create a cleaner visual outer-leg line in certain trouser constructions.

noticeably_shifted_seam.description: A seam that sits noticeably away from the intended outer leg line can make the trouser silhouette appear uneven or twisted.

rules.styling_tip: Consider side seam position together with trouser leg shape, outseam alignment and fabric drape. The seam should follow the intended direction of the leg rather than twisting around it.

rules.name: Shirt cuff height guidance
rules.guideline: The height of a shirt cuff affects how much cuff is visible at the wrist and how the sleeve transitions into the hand.

low_cuff_height.description: A shorter cuff creates a subtle wrist finish and keeps the sleeve appearance relatively streamlined.

standard_cuff_height.description: A conventional cuff height provides balanced wrist coverage and works across common shirt styles.

high_cuff_height.description: A taller cuff creates more visual presence around the wrist and can make the sleeve finish more noticeable.

rules.styling_tip: Consider cuff height together with cuff width, sleeve length and watch size. The cuff should remain proportionate to the sleeve and wrist.

rules.name: Hoodie shoulder seam position guidance
rules.guideline: The position of a hoodie shoulder seam affects how the upper body and sleeves visually connect.

on_shoulder.description: A seam sitting close to the natural shoulder creates a cleaner and more defined upper-body structure.

slightly_dropped.description: A seam positioned slightly beyond the natural shoulder creates a relaxed appearance without making the entire garment extremely oversized.

strongly_dropped.description: A seam extending noticeably beyond the natural shoulder creates a broader, more relaxed upper silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider shoulder seam position together with hoodie body width, sleeve width and overall length. A strongly dropped shoulder works best when the rest of the silhouette supports the relaxed proportion.

rules.name: Cardigan button placket proportion guidance
rules.guideline: The width and visual weight of a cardigan's button placket affect how the front opening balances with the knitwear body.

narrow_placket.description: A narrow placket keeps the front opening visually light and allows the knit texture to remain the main focus.

standard_placket.description: A balanced placket creates a proportional transition between the button opening and the cardigan body.

wide_placket.description: A wider placket creates stronger visual structure around the front opening and can complement heavier knitwear.

rules.styling_tip: Consider placket proportion together with knit gauge, cardigan width and button size. Heavier knitwear can support a stronger front structure, while fine knits generally benefit from lighter detailing.

rules.name: Cardigan button spacing guidance
rules.guideline: The spacing between cardigan buttons affects the visual rhythm of the front opening and how the knitwear appears when worn.

close_spacing.description: Closely spaced buttons create a more continuous and structured front closure.

balanced_spacing.description: Moderate spacing creates an even visual rhythm while keeping the cardigan practical and proportionate.

wide_spacing.description: Wider spacing creates a more open visual rhythm and can give the cardigan a relaxed appearance.

rules.styling_tip: Consider button spacing together with placket width, button size and cardigan length. The spacing should remain visually consistent with the scale of the knitwear.

rules.name: Trouser seat drape guidance
rules.guideline: The way trouser fabric falls over the seat affects comfort, rear silhouette and the overall smoothness of the trousers.

clean_seat_drape.description: Fabric follows the seat smoothly with enough ease for movement and minimal excess material.

relaxed_seat_drape.description: Additional fabric provides more room through the seat and creates a softer, less fitted rear silhouette.

tight_seat_drape.description: Limited ease can create horizontal pulling or tension lines across the seat and restrict movement.

rules.styling_tip: Consider seat drape together with waist fit, rise, thigh fit and leg shape. The seat should allow comfortable movement without excessive fabric pooling.

rules.name: Cardigan sleeve opening guidance
rules.guideline: The width of the sleeve opening at the wrist affects how the cardigan sleeve falls and how easily it layers over a shirt.

narrow_opening.description: A narrower sleeve opening creates a cleaner wrist finish and keeps the sleeve closer to the arm.

standard_opening.description: A moderate sleeve opening provides balanced movement while maintaining a controlled sleeve shape.

wide_opening.description: A wider opening allows easier layering over shirts and creates a more relaxed sleeve finish.

rules.styling_tip: Consider sleeve opening together with sleeve width, knit thickness and the layers worn underneath. Wider openings are more practical when the cardigan is designed for layering.

rules.name: Cardigan body buttoning level guidance
rules.guideline: The level at which a cardigan is buttoned changes the visual balance between the neckline, chest and lower torso.

upper_buttoning.description: Buttoning mainly through the upper section keeps the lower front open and creates a more relaxed vertical opening.

mid_buttoning.description: Buttoning through the middle section creates a balanced front structure while maintaining some openness.

full_buttoning.description: Buttoning most or all of the front creates greater coverage and a more continuous knitwear silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider buttoning level together with cardigan length, neckline and fit. Leaving part of the front open can create visual layering, while fuller buttoning gives a more unified appearance.

rules.name: Trouser front panel width guidance
rules.guideline: The width of the front trouser panel affects how much visual space is created across the front of the upper leg.

narrow_front_panel.description: A narrower front panel creates a more streamlined visual appearance through the upper leg.

standard_front_panel.description: A proportionate front panel provides balanced visual width and supports a natural trouser silhouette.

wide_front_panel.description: A wider front panel creates more visual space and can support a fuller trouser silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider front panel width together with leg width, pleat structure and fabric drape. The panel should visually support the intended trouser silhouette without creating unnecessary bulk.

rules.name: Knitwear shoulder drop guidance
rules.guideline: The amount a knitwear shoulder extends beyond the natural shoulder affects the upper-body silhouette and sleeve transition.

minimal_drop.description: A shoulder close to the natural shoulder creates a cleaner and more defined upper-body shape.

moderate_drop.description: A moderate shoulder drop creates a relaxed appearance while keeping the overall silhouette controlled.

strong_drop.description: A pronounced shoulder drop creates a broader and more relaxed upper silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider shoulder drop together with knitwear body width, sleeve width and garment length. A stronger drop works best when the rest of the garment supports the relaxed proportion.

rules.name: Knitwear neck opening depth guidance
rules.guideline: The depth of a knitwear neckline affects how much of the neck and upper chest is visible and changes the layering balance.

shallow_opening.description: A shallower neckline keeps more coverage around the upper chest and creates a compact appearance.

moderate_opening.description: A moderate neckline provides balanced chest visibility and works well with simple layers underneath.

deep_opening.description: A deeper neckline creates more visible space around the neck and upper chest and allows more of an inner layer to show.

rules.styling_tip: Consider neckline depth together with collar shape, garment thickness and the layer underneath. Deeper openings benefit from intentional inner-layer coordination.

rules.name: Knitwear shoulder width guidance
rules.guideline: The shoulder width of knitwear affects the visual breadth of the upper body and how naturally the garment transitions into the sleeves.

narrow_shoulder.description: A narrower shoulder creates a closer and more streamlined upper-body appearance.

standard_shoulder.description: A proportionate shoulder width creates balanced upper-body structure and a natural sleeve transition.

wide_shoulder.description: A wider shoulder creates a broader upper silhouette and supports a more relaxed garment structure.

rules.styling_tip: Consider shoulder width together with knitwear body width, sleeve width and garment length. The shoulder should support the intended silhouette without creating unnecessary bulk.

rules.name: Knitwear side slit guidance
rules.guideline: Side slits in knitwear affect lower-body movement and change how the garment falls over trousers or other bottoms.

no_side_slit.description: A closed side seam creates a continuous lower silhouette and keeps the garment more contained around the hips.

short_side_slit.description: A short slit adds some movement around the lower hem while maintaining a mostly continuous silhouette.

long_side_slit.description: A longer slit allows greater movement and creates more separation between the front and back hem.

rules.styling_tip: Consider side slit length together with garment length, knit thickness and bottom fit. Longer slits work particularly well when the knitwear extends below the hip.

rules.name: Jacket pocket type guidance
rules.guideline: The construction of jacket pockets affects the visual formality, structure and overall character of the garment.

welt_pockets.description: A clean slit-like pocket creates a streamlined and refined appearance with minimal visual bulk.

flap_pockets.description: A pocket with a visible flap adds more visual structure while remaining versatile across tailored jackets.

patch_pockets.description: An externally attached pocket creates a more casual and visibly relaxed character.

rules.styling_tip: Consider pocket type together with jacket structure, fabric weight and overall formality. Cleaner pocket constructions generally suit sharper tailoring, while patch pockets support relaxed silhouettes.

rules.name: Trouser fly construction guidance
rules.guideline: The construction of the trouser fly affects the cleanliness and visual structure of the front waistband and closure area.

zip_fly.description: A concealed zip closure creates a clean and relatively minimal front appearance.

button_fly.description: A button-based closure creates a more traditional front construction and can add subtle visual detail.

extended_tab_closure.description: An extended waistband tab creates a more tailored and structured closure with additional visual definition at the waist.

rules.styling_tip: Consider fly construction together with waistband design, closure type and overall trouser formality. The front closure should integrate cleanly with the waistband rather than creating unnecessary bulk.

rules.name: Trouser pocket opening angle guidance
rules.guideline: The angle of a trouser pocket opening affects the visual lines around the upper hip and front pocket area.

shallow_angle.description: A gently angled opening creates a subtle and relatively clean line across the upper hip.

standard_angle.description: A moderate pocket angle provides practical hand access while maintaining balanced visual proportions.

steep_angle.description: A more pronounced angle creates a stronger diagonal line and gives the pocket area greater visual definition.

rules.styling_tip: Consider pocket opening angle together with pocket placement, trouser rise and front panel width. The opening should follow the intended trouser silhouette without distorting the hip area.

rules.name: Shirt cuff closure type guidance
rules.guideline: The type of cuff closure affects the structure, formality and visual character of the shirt wrist area.

single_button_cuff.description: A simple single-button closure creates a clean and versatile wrist finish.

double_button_cuff.description: Two buttons provide adjustable wrist circumference and create a slightly more structured cuff appearance.

french_cuff.description: A fold-back cuff creates a more formal and distinctive wrist finish, usually styled with cufflinks.

rules.styling_tip: Consider cuff closure together with cuff width, sleeve length and the formality of the outfit. More formal closures should remain proportionate to the shirt and accessories.

rules.name: Shirt shoulder pleat guidance
rules.guideline: Pleats near the shoulder or upper back can add movement ease and influence how relaxed the shirt appears.

no_shoulder_pleat.description: A clean shoulder area creates a streamlined appearance with controlled fabric around the upper back.

small_shoulder_pleat.description: A small pleat adds limited movement ease while keeping the upper-back structure relatively clean.

pronounced_shoulder_pleat.description: A more noticeable pleat provides additional fabric movement and creates a relaxed upper-back appearance.

rules.styling_tip: Consider shoulder pleats together with the back yoke, back pleat structure and shirt body width. Added ease should support movement without creating unnecessary bulk.

rules.name: Jacket sleeve head shape guidance
rules.guideline: The shape of the sleeve head affects how smoothly the sleeve rises from the shoulder and contributes to the jacket's upper-arm silhouette.

natural_sleeve_head.description: A softly shaped sleeve head creates a natural transition from the shoulder into the upper arm.

structured_sleeve_head.description: A more defined sleeve head creates a cleaner shoulder-to-sleeve transition and stronger upper-body structure.

rounded_sleeve_head.description: A fuller rounded sleeve head creates more visible volume around the upper arm and gives the jacket a softer silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider sleeve head shape together with shoulder structure, sleeve pitch and armhole depth. The sleeve head should transition naturally from the jacket shoulder without creating unnecessary bulk.

rules.name: Trouser pocket bag bulk guidance
rules.guideline: The amount of fabric and contents inside a trouser pocket can affect how smoothly the upper hip and thigh area appears.

low_bulk.description: A flatter pocket area keeps the trouser front and upper hip visually clean.

moderate_bulk.description: A moderate pocket volume allows practical storage while maintaining a relatively smooth trouser silhouette.

high_bulk.description: A larger pocket volume or heavy contents can create visible pulling or outward projection around the hip.

rules.styling_tip: Consider pocket bag bulk together with trouser fit, fabric weight and pocket opening. Avoid overloading pockets when a clean silhouette is the styling goal.

rules.name: Trousers knee width guidance
rules.guideline: The width of trousers around the knee affects how smoothly the leg transitions from the thigh toward the lower leg.

narrow_knee.description: A narrower knee creates a more streamlined transition and supports a tapered leg appearance.

standard_knee.description: A balanced knee width provides natural movement while maintaining consistent leg proportions.

wide_knee.description: A wider knee provides greater movement and supports a fuller, more relaxed leg silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider knee width together with thigh fit, leg shape and trouser leg opening. The knee should transition naturally into the lower leg rather than creating an abrupt change in width.

rules.name: Jacket lining back pleat guidance
rules.guideline: A back pleat in the jacket lining provides additional movement allowance without changing the outer jacket silhouette.

no_back_pleat.description: A lining without a back pleat gives a cleaner internal construction but provides less extra movement allowance.

single_back_pleat.description: A single pleat in the center back lining provides additional movement while keeping the internal construction relatively clean.

side_back_pleats.description: Pleats positioned toward the back sides provide movement allowance across the upper back while distributing extra lining volume.

rules.styling_tip: The lining pleat should provide movement without creating excessive internal fabric bulk or pulling when the jacket is worn.

rules.name: Blazer sleeve button spacing guidance
rules.guideline: The spacing between sleeve buttons affects the visual rhythm and finishing of a blazer sleeve.

minimal_spacing.description: Closely spaced buttons create a compact and understated sleeve finish.

balanced_spacing.description: Moderately spaced buttons create a traditional and proportionate sleeve finish.

wide_spacing.description: More widely spaced buttons create a less compact and more visually relaxed sleeve finish.

rules.styling_tip: Keep sleeve button spacing visually consistent with the sleeve length, cuff proportion and overall tailoring style.

rules.name: Jacket back panel shape guidance
rules.guideline: The shape and contour of the jacket back panel affect how smoothly the garment follows the upper back and creates the overall rear silhouette.

straight_back_panel.description: A relatively straight back panel creates a clean and structured rear silhouette.

contoured_back_panel.description: A gently shaped back panel follows the body's natural contour and creates a more fitted silhouette.

relaxed_back_panel.description: A roomier back panel provides more visual ease and supports a relaxed outerwear silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Evaluate the back panel together with shoulder structure, back length and overall jacket ease so the rear silhouette remains balanced.

rules.name: Jacket sleeve vent length guidance
rules.guideline: The length of the sleeve vent affects the visual finish of the jacket cuff and how the sleeve opens toward the wrist.

short_vent.description: A shorter sleeve vent creates a compact and clean cuff finish.

standard_vent.description: A moderate sleeve vent provides a balanced traditional finish and allows comfortable cuff movement.

long_vent.description: A longer sleeve vent creates a more noticeable cuff opening and can add visual detail to the sleeve.

rules.styling_tip: Keep the sleeve vent proportionate to the sleeve length and cuff construction so the wrist area does not look visually crowded.

rules.name: Shirt cuff placket length guidance
rules.guideline: The cuff placket length affects the transition from the shirt sleeve opening into the cuff and contributes to the sleeve's finishing detail.

short_placket.description: A shorter placket creates a compact and understated transition into the cuff.

standard_placket.description: A balanced placket length provides a conventional transition between the sleeve opening and cuff.

long_placket.description: A longer placket creates a more noticeable vertical detail near the wrist and can add visual interest.

rules.styling_tip: Keep the cuff placket proportionate to the sleeve opening and cuff construction so the wrist area maintains a clean visual transition.

rules.name: Jacket waist suppression guidance
rules.guideline: Waist suppression describes how much a jacket narrows from the chest toward the waist and strongly affects the jacket's torso silhouette.

low_suppression.description: A straighter shape from chest to waist creates a relaxed and less tapered torso silhouette.

moderate_suppression.description: A controlled taper from chest to waist creates a balanced tailored silhouette without excessive shaping.

high_suppression.description: A stronger taper creates a more defined waist and pronounced tailored torso shape.

rules.styling_tip: Choose waist suppression together with chest structure, jacket ease and overall body fit so the torso remains balanced without excessive pulling around the waist.

rules.name: Jacket front dart placement guidance
rules.guideline: The placement of front darts shapes the jacket torso and influences how the fabric transitions from the chest toward the waist.

higher_dart.description: A dart positioned higher on the torso creates more shaping closer to the chest and can produce a sharper tailored contour.

standard_dart.description: A balanced dart position distributes torso shaping naturally from the chest toward the waist.

lower_dart.description: A lower dart position creates shaping farther down the torso and can support a more relaxed visual transition.

rules.styling_tip: Consider dart placement together with waist suppression, chest structure and jacket length so the front torso remains visually balanced.

rules.name: Casual outfit combination guidance
rules.guideline: A casual outfit should balance comfort, relaxed proportions and simple coordinated colours without looking overly formal.

elevated_casual.formula: well-fitted shirt/overshirt + relaxed trousers + clean sneakers or loafers

rules.styling_tip: Keep one clear focal piece and make the remaining garments simpler so the outfit feels coordinated rather than visually crowded.

rules.name: Smart-casual outfit combination guidance
rules.guideline: Smart-casual outfits combine polished pieces with relaxed elements to create a look that is refined without becoming fully formal.

shirt_based.formula: casual or oxford shirt + chinos/trousers + loafers or clean sneakers

polo_based.formula: polo shirt + tailored trousers/chinos + loafers or minimal sneakers

layered_smart_casual.formula: plain t-shirt or shirt + overshirt/light blazer + tailored trousers + clean footwear

rules.styling_tip: Combine at least one polished element with relaxed pieces, and keep footwear clean and proportionate to the overall outfit.

rules.name: Date outfit combination guidance
rules.guideline: A date outfit should look intentional, comfortable and well-coordinated while matching the venue and level of formality.

casual_date.formula: plain t-shirt or polo + well-fitted jeans/trousers + clean sneakers

smart_date.formula: shirt or refined polo + chinos/trousers + loafers or minimal sneakers

layered_date.formula: plain base layer + overshirt/light jacket + trousers/jeans + clean footwear

rules.styling_tip: Prioritize a clean fit, coordinated colours and simple accessories. Adjust the outfit's formality to the venue rather than following one fixed date outfit.

rules.name: Office outfit combination guidance
rules.guideline: An office outfit should balance the workplace dress code with clean fit, coordinated colours and appropriate footwear.

formal_office.formula: dress shirt + tailored trousers + formal shoes or loafers

business_casual.formula: oxford/casual shirt or polo + chinos/tailored trousers + loafers or clean sneakers

casual_office.formula: plain t-shirt or casual shirt + clean trousers/chinos + minimal sneakers

rules.styling_tip: Match the outfit's formality to the workplace dress code and keep logos, excessive accessories and overly distressed garments limited when a polished appearance is expected.

rules.name: Wedding guest outfit combination guidance
rules.guideline: A wedding guest outfit should balance festive character with the formality of the ceremony, venue and time of day.

modern_ethnic.formula: kurta + tailored trousers/churidar + loafers/mojaris + minimal accessories

western_formal.formula: shirt + tailored trousers or suit + formal shoes/loafers

rules.styling_tip: Use richer colours, refined fabrics or subtle accessories for festive character, while keeping the overall outfit appropriate to the wedding dress code.

rules.name: Travel outfit combination guidance
rules.guideline: A travel outfit should prioritize comfort and movement while maintaining a coordinated and presentable appearance.

layered_travel.formula: t-shirt + overshirt/light jacket + relaxed trousers/jeans + sneakers

elevated_travel.formula: polo/overshirt + relaxed tailored trousers + clean sneakers or loafers

rules.styling_tip: Prefer comfortable fabrics, practical footwear and relaxed-but-controlled fits. Keep the colour palette coordinated so comfort does not make the outfit look careless.

rules.name: Party outfit combination guidance
rules.guideline: A party outfit can use stronger colours, sharper silhouettes or statement pieces while keeping the overall combination coordinated.

smart_party.formula: refined shirt/polo + tailored trousers + loafers or minimal sneakers

statement_party.formula: statement shirt/jacket + simple base pieces + clean footwear + controlled accessories

rules.styling_tip: If one garment is visually strong through colour, print, texture or silhouette, keep the remaining pieces simpler to maintain balance.

rules.name: Monsoon outfit combination guidance
rules.guideline: Monsoon outfits should balance weather practicality, quick-drying fabrics, comfortable fits and coordinated styling.

everyday_monsoon.formula: lightweight t-shirt + practical trousers/jeans + water-resistant sneakers

layered_monsoon.formula: quick-drying base layer + lightweight overshirt/jacket + trousers + practical footwear

smart_monsoon.formula: lightweight shirt/polo + tailored trousers/chinos + practical loafers or water-resistant footwear

rules.styling_tip: Prefer breathable or quick-drying fabrics and avoid unnecessarily heavy layers. Keep footwear practical for wet conditions while maintaining the outfit's overall colour and fit balance.

rules.name: Summer outfit combination guidance
rules.guideline: Summer outfits should prioritize breathability, lightweight construction and comfortable proportions while maintaining a coordinated appearance.

casual_summer.formula: lightweight t-shirt + relaxed trousers/jeans + breathable sneakers

shirt_summer.formula: linen/cotton shirt + lightweight trousers/chinos + loafers or minimal sneakers

shorts_summer.formula: breathable t-shirt/shirt + tailored shorts + clean sneakers or casual loafers

rules.styling_tip: Choose breathable fabrics and avoid unnecessarily heavy layers. Keep the silhouette relaxed enough for comfort while maintaining clean proportions.

rules.name: Winter outfit combination guidance
rules.guideline: Winter outfits should combine warmth, practical layering and balanced proportions without making the silhouette unnecessarily bulky.

casual_winter.formula: t-shirt/sweatshirt + jeans or relaxed trousers + sneakers/boots

layered_winter.formula: base layer + overshirt/sweater + jacket/coat + trousers + suitable footwear

smart_winter.formula: shirt/turtleneck + tailored trousers + blazer/coat + loafers or boots

rules.styling_tip: Build warmth through multiple controlled layers rather than relying on one oversized garment. Keep the outer layer proportionate to the layers underneath.

rules.name: Festival outfit combination guidance
rules.guideline: Festival outfits can combine traditional or contemporary pieces with richer colours, refined textures and subtle accessories.

traditional_festival.formula: kurta + ethnic bottom + loafers/mojaris + minimal accessories

modern_festival.formula: kurta/short kurta + tailored trousers + loafers/minimal sneakers + subtle accessories

contemporary_festival.formula: solid shirt/overshirt + tailored trousers + refined footwear + one festive accent

rules.styling_tip: Use one or two festive elements as the visual focus and keep the remaining pieces coordinated so the outfit does not become overly busy.

rules.name: Footwear formality matching guidance
rules.guideline: Footwear should match the overall formality level of the clothing so the outfit feels visually consistent.
rules.styling_tip: Avoid a large formality mismatch, such as very casual footwear with highly formal tailoring, unless the contrast is intentional.

rules.name: Accessory density guidance
rules.guideline: The number and visual strength of accessories should stay balanced with the outfit's overall complexity.

minimal_accessories.description: One or two subtle accessories keep the outfit clean and understated.

balanced_accessories.description: A watch combined with one additional accessory adds detail without making the outfit visually crowded.

statement_accessories.description: A noticeable accessory can become the focal point while the remaining accessories stay restrained.

rules.styling_tip: When the clothing already has bold colours, prints or strong silhouettes, reduce accessory density. If the outfit is simple, one statement accessory can add visual interest.

rules.name: Accessory scale guidance
rules.guideline: The physical size and visual weight of accessories should complement the proportions and visual strength of the outfit.

small_scale.description: Slim watches, delicate chains and compact accessories create a subtle finish.

medium_scale.description: Moderately sized accessories provide visible detail while remaining proportionate to most outfits.

large_scale.description: Larger watches, chains, bags or other accessories create stronger visual weight and work better with substantial garments.

rules.styling_tip: Match accessory scale with garment proportions. Substantial clothing can support stronger accessories, while delicate or highly fitted outfits usually benefit from lighter visual weight.

rules.name: Outfit texture coordination guidance
rules.guideline: Combining fabric textures can add depth to an outfit, but the textures should remain visually balanced.

smooth_base.description: Smooth fabrics create a clean foundation that allows one textured piece to stand out.

mixed_texture.description: Combining different subtle textures creates visual depth without requiring strong colour contrast.

strong_texture.description: A visibly textured garment can act as the main visual element while simpler fabrics keep the outfit balanced.

rules.styling_tip: When one garment has a strong texture, keep the other pieces relatively simple in texture so the outfit does not become visually overloaded.

rules.name: Outfit focal point guidance
rules.guideline: A clear focal point gives the outfit visual direction and prevents multiple garments or accessories from competing for attention.

upper_body_focal.description: A distinctive shirt, jacket, print or neckline draws primary attention toward the upper body.

lower_body_focal.description: Distinctive trousers, jeans or footwear make the lower half the main visual focus.

accessory_focal.description: One noticeable accessory becomes the visual highlight while the clothing remains relatively controlled.

rules.styling_tip: Choose one primary focal point and support it with simpler surrounding pieces. Avoid giving equal visual emphasis to multiple statement elements unless the look is intentionally maximalist.

rules.name: Outfit visual weight distribution guidance
rules.guideline: Visual weight comes from garment volume, colour intensity, texture, layering and accessories, and its distribution affects overall outfit balance.

upper_heavy.description: A visually heavier upper body can be balanced with simpler or moderately structured bottoms.

lower_heavy.description: A visually heavier lower body can be balanced with a cleaner upper body or controlled layering.

balanced_distribution.description: Similar visual weight across the upper and lower body creates an evenly distributed silhouette.

rules.styling_tip: Consider garment volume together with colour contrast, texture and accessories. If one area is visually dominant, simplify the opposite area to maintain balance.

rules.name: Outfit repetition and continuity guidance
rules.guideline: Repeating related visual elements across an outfit can create continuity and make separate garments appear intentionally coordinated.

colour_repetition.description: Repeating a colour in different areas connects separate pieces visually.

material_repetition.description: Repeating a related material or finish can create subtle visual connection between garments or accessories.

detail_repetition.description: Repeating small details such as metal finish, pattern elements or design accents creates visual continuity.

rules.styling_tip: Repeat one or two visual elements rather than copying every detail. Controlled repetition creates cohesion without making the outfit look overly matched.

rules.name: Outfit contrast level guidance
rules.guideline: The overall contrast between garments affects how sharp, subtle or visually defined an outfit appears.

low_contrast.description: Closely related colours, tones and visual values create a softer and more continuous appearance.

medium_contrast.description: Moderate differences between the upper and lower pieces create definition while keeping the outfit balanced.

high_contrast.description: Strong differences in colour or visual value create a sharper and more noticeable outfit separation.

rules.styling_tip: Choose the contrast level according to the desired visual effect. When using high contrast, keep unnecessary patterns and accessories controlled.

rules.name: Outfit pattern scale guidance
rules.guideline: The size and density of patterns affect how visually prominent a garment appears and how it interacts with the rest of the outfit.

small_scale_pattern.description: Small, closely spaced patterns create a subtle visual effect and are easier to combine with other simple pieces.

medium_scale_pattern.description: Medium-sized patterns provide visible character while maintaining a balanced overall appearance.

large_scale_pattern.description: Large or widely spaced patterns create stronger visual impact and usually work best as the main statement element.

rules.styling_tip: When using a large or visually dense pattern, keep surrounding garments relatively simple in colour, texture and design.

rules.name: Outfit pattern mixing guidance
rules.guideline: Multiple patterns can work together when their scale, visual density and colour relationship are controlled.

one_pattern.description: Using one patterned garment with solid surrounding pieces creates the easiest balanced combination.

two_related_patterns.description: Two patterns can be combined when they share a colour family or have clearly different scales.

multiple_strong_patterns.description: Several bold patterns create high visual complexity and require deliberate coordination.

rules.styling_tip: If mixing patterns, control at least one variable such as colour, scale or density. Keep footwear and accessories simple when pattern complexity is already high.

rules.name: Outfit layering depth guidance
rules.guideline: The number of visible clothing layers affects visual depth, warmth and the overall complexity of an outfit.

single_layer.description: One main clothing layer creates a clean and simple appearance with low visual complexity.

two_layers.description: A base garment combined with an outer layer adds depth while remaining relatively easy to balance.

three_or_more_layers.description: Multiple visible layers create greater depth and visual complexity and require careful proportion control.

rules.styling_tip: As layering depth increases, keep colour relationships, garment lengths and visual weight controlled so the outfit does not appear cluttered.

rules.name: Outfit base layer selection guidance
rules.guideline: The base layer sets the visual and functional foundation for the layers worn over it.

tshirt_base.description: A plain or simple t-shirt provides a clean foundation and works easily under casual layers.

shirt_base.description: A shirt creates a more polished foundation and can transition between casual and smart-casual layering.

turtleneck_base.description: A fitted turtleneck creates a clean continuous neckline and works as a refined foundation under structured outer layers.

rules.styling_tip: Choose a base layer that fits comfortably underneath the outer garment without creating unnecessary bunching or excessive fabric around the torso and neckline.

rules.name: Outfit layer order guidance
rules.guideline: The order of garments from inner to outer affects comfort, visibility, proportion and how naturally the layers interact.

light_to_heavy.description: Lighter and thinner garments are placed underneath heavier outer layers to maintain a clean silhouette.

short_to_long.description: Layer lengths can gradually increase outward to create a controlled visual hierarchy.

structured_outer.description: A structured outer garment works best over layers that remain relatively controlled in volume.

rules.styling_tip: Avoid placing a bulky inner layer under a closely fitted outer garment. Keep the layer order practical while maintaining visible length and proportion differences.

rules.name: Outfit material formality guidance
rules.guideline: Fabric choice contributes to how casual, refined or formal an outfit appears alongside its cut and styling.
rules.styling_tip: Coordinate material formality across the outfit. A refined or formal garment can be balanced with simpler pieces, but avoid large mismatches unless the contrast is intentional.

rules.name: Outfit finish and sheen guidance
rules.guideline: The surface finish of garments and accessories, from matte to glossy, affects how formal, subtle or attention-grabbing an outfit appears.

matte_finish.description: Matte surfaces absorb more visual light and create a subdued, understated appearance.

subtle_sheen.description: A moderate surface sheen adds refinement and visual depth without becoming the main focus.

high_sheen.description: Glossy or reflective surfaces create stronger visual emphasis and can make a garment or accessory feel more dramatic.

rules.styling_tip: When one piece has a strong glossy finish, keep other surfaces relatively controlled so the outfit maintains a clear visual hierarchy.

rules.name: Outfit proportion rhythm guidance
rules.guideline: The relative size of garments across different parts of an outfit creates a visual rhythm that can make the overall silhouette feel intentional or unbalanced.

consistent_volume.description: Similar levels of garment volume create a relaxed and visually continuous silhouette.

controlled_contrast.description: Different garment volumes can create intentional contrast when the transition between them remains visually controlled.

progressive_volume.description: Gradually changing garment volume from one layer to another creates a more structured visual progression.

rules.styling_tip: Avoid accidental volume jumps between garments. When contrasting loose and fitted pieces, make the difference look intentional through clear proportion relationships.

rules.name: Outfit style consistency guidance
rules.guideline: Garments, footwear and accessories should generally support the same overall style direction unless a deliberate contrast is intended.

casual_consistency.description: Relaxed garments paired with casual footwear and understated accessories create a cohesive everyday look.

smart_consistency.description: Refined garments, polished footwear and controlled accessories create a coordinated smart-casual appearance.

streetwear_consistency.description: Relaxed silhouettes, statement pieces and substantial footwear can work together to create a cohesive streetwear direction.

rules.styling_tip: Identify the dominant style direction first, then choose supporting garments and accessories. Intentional style contrast can work when the transition is visually controlled.

rules.name: Outfit occasion formality balance guidance
rules.guideline: The formality of individual garments should work together to suit the expected dress level of the occasion.

relaxed.description: Casual garments and relaxed footwear create a low-formality combination suitable for informal settings.

polished_casual.description: A mix of refined and relaxed pieces creates a polished appearance without becoming fully formal.

formal.description: Structured garments and formal footwear create a consistent high-formality combination.

rules.styling_tip: Avoid accidental formality mismatches between major garments and footwear. If mixing levels intentionally, make one clear piece the bridge between them.

rules.name: Outfit visual anchor guidance
rules.guideline: A visual anchor is the element that establishes the outfit's main character and helps the remaining pieces support a unified look.

garment_anchor.description: A distinctive shirt, jacket, trousers or other garment establishes the primary character of the outfit.

footwear_anchor.description: Distinctive footwear can establish the outfit's character while the clothing remains comparatively controlled.

accessory_anchor.description: A noticeable watch, chain, bag or other accessory can provide the defining detail in an otherwise simple outfit.

rules.styling_tip: Use one clear visual anchor and let the surrounding pieces support it through compatible colour, proportion and style rather than competing for attention.

rules.name: Shirt and trousers formality matching guidance
rules.guideline: The formality level of a shirt and trousers should generally complement each other to create a coherent outfit.

casual_pairing.description: Casual shirts paired with jeans, relaxed trousers or chinos create an easy everyday combination.

smart_casual_pairing.description: A refined shirt paired with chinos or tailored trousers creates a polished but relaxed combination.

formal_pairing.description: Dress shirts paired with tailored formal trousers create a consistent formal foundation.

rules.styling_tip: When combining different formality levels, use footwear and accessories to bridge the difference rather than allowing the shirt and trousers to feel disconnected.

rules.name: Outfit silhouette direction guidance
rules.guideline: The overall silhouette can be straight, tapered, relaxed or deliberately contrasted, and the chosen direction should remain visually coherent across the outfit.

straight_silhouette.description: Similar width through the upper and lower body creates a clean, continuous silhouette.

tapered_silhouette.description: The outfit gradually becomes narrower toward the lower body, creating a more streamlined appearance.

relaxed_silhouette.description: Greater garment volume throughout the outfit creates a loose and comfortable overall shape.

contrasted_silhouette.description: Different volumes between the upper and lower body create a deliberate proportion contrast.

rules.styling_tip: Choose a dominant silhouette direction and make contrasting proportions look intentional rather than accidental.

rules.name: Outfit occasion and time matching guidance
rules.guideline: The same outfit category can feel different depending on whether it is worn during the day or evening, so styling should consider both occasion and time.

daytime.description: Daytime outfits generally work well with lighter visual tones, breathable fabrics and less dramatic styling.

evening.description: Evening outfits can support deeper colours, richer textures and slightly more refined or defined styling.

formal_evening.description: Formal evening settings generally suit structured garments, refined fabrics and controlled accessories.

rules.styling_tip: Consider venue, dress code, weather and lighting along with the time of day. Time alone should not determine the outfit.

rules.name: Outfit garment coordination guidance
rules.guideline: Each garment should support the overall outfit through compatible style, proportion, colour, texture or function rather than appearing randomly combined.

supporting_garments.description: Simple supporting pieces allow the main garment to remain visually clear without creating unnecessary competition.

complementary_garments.description: Pieces with compatible silhouettes, colours and materials create a naturally coordinated outfit.

intentional_contrast.description: Contrasting garments can work when their differences create a deliberate styling direction rather than an accidental mismatch.

rules.styling_tip: Evaluate the complete outfit instead of judging garments individually. If one piece introduces strong contrast, use the remaining pieces to establish visual connection.

rules.name: Outfit occasion activity alignment
rules.guideline: An outfit should suit not only the occasion but also the physical activity expected during that occasion.

low_activity.description: For sitting, dining or relaxed social settings, structured and polished outfits can work well.
examples: shirt + tailored trousers + loafers
polo + chinos + loafers

moderate_activity.description: For walking, shopping or casual outings, choose comfortable garments and footwear while maintaining a coordinated appearance.
examples: oversized t-shirt + relaxed trousers + sneakers
overshirt + straight jeans + sneakers

high_activity.description: For activities involving extended walking or movement, prioritize mobility, breathable fabrics and supportive footwear.
examples: t-shirt + relaxed trousers + comfortable sneakers
lightweight shirt + shorts + sneakers

rules.styling_tip: When recommending an outfit, consider what the person will actually do while wearing it, not only where they are going.

rules.name: Outfit weather adaptation guidance
rules.guideline: Outfits should adapt to actual weather conditions while maintaining the intended style direction.
