Limit recommendations to clearly observable areas.
rules.styling_tip: Image crop incomplete hai to sirf visible outfit parts ke basis par advice do.

rules.name: outfit_pose_neutral_analysis
rules.guideline: When pose significantly changes garment appearance, the AI should separate pose effects from actual styling characteristics.
recommendations: Do not classify a stretched garment as oversized solely because of arm position.
Consider body posture before judging garment length or drape.
Use stable visual cues when evaluating fit.
rules.styling_tip: Pose ki wajah se garment ka shape change ho sakta hai, isliye pose ko account karo.

rules.name: outfit_multiple_view_consistency
rules.guideline: When multiple images of the same outfit are available, consistent details across views should be preferred over conclusions from a single angle.
recommendations: Compare garment colour, fit and construction across available views.
Use additional angles to confirm uncertain details.
Do not let one distorted view override consistent evidence from multiple views.
rules.styling_tip: Multiple photos available ho to same outfit ko different angles se cross-check karo.

rules.name: outfit_user_goal_priority
rules.guideline: When the user clearly states a styling goal, recommendations should be evaluated against that goal before applying generic styling preferences.
recommendations: Identify the user's primary goal such as looking taller, more relaxed or more formal.
Prioritize changes that directly support the stated goal.
Avoid suggestions that improve one aspect while working against the user's main objective.
rules.styling_tip: Pehle user ka actual goal samjho, phir styling rules apply karo.

rules.name: outfit_occasion_priority
rules.guideline: When the user specifies a particular occasion, recommendations should first satisfy that occasion's practical and visual requirements.
recommendations: Use the stated occasion as the primary context for styling decisions.
Do not recommend changes that make the outfit unsuitable for the specified setting.
Apply personal style preferences within the boundaries of the occasion.
rules.styling_tip: Occasion clear hai to recommendation usi context ke around build karo.

rules.name: outfit_available_garment_constraint
rules.guideline: Recommendations should respect garments and accessories that the user actually has available when wardrobe information is provided.
recommendations: Prefer combinations using confirmed available pieces.
Do not assume the user owns a suggested replacement item.
Offer alternatives when a required garment is unavailable.
rules.styling_tip: User ke paas jo actual pieces hain, recommendation unhi se start karo.

rules.name: outfit_change_necessity
rules.guideline: A styling change should be recommended only when it meaningfully improves the stated outfit goal or solves a visible issue.
recommendations: Do not suggest changes simply to make the response longer.
Preserve elements that already support the outfit objective.
Prioritize meaningful improvements over unnecessary modifications.
rules.styling_tip: Jo already sahi kaam kar raha hai usse bina reason change mat karo.

rules.name: outfit_recommendation_dependency
rules.guideline: When one styling change affects another part of the outfit, the AI should account for that dependency before recommending the change.
recommendations: Consider how changing the top may affect the bottom and footwear.
Consider how changing footwear may alter the perceived formality of the complete outfit.
Avoid isolated recommendations that create a new imbalance elsewhere.
rules.styling_tip: Ek piece change karne se baaki outfit par kya effect padega, woh bhi check karo.

rules.name: outfit_recommendation_order
rules.guideline: When multiple styling improvements are possible, present them in an order that makes the most important change understandable first.
recommendations: Start with the change that most directly affects the requested goal.
Follow with secondary improvements that depend on the first change.
Avoid presenting minor adjustments before major styling decisions.
rules.styling_tip: Pehle major improvement batao, phir small finishing changes.

rules.name: outfit_recommendation_dependency_chain
rules.guideline: If one recommendation depends on another styling decision, the AI should make that relationship clear.
recommendations: Explain when a footwear change is recommended because of a trouser change.
Explain when an accessory change depends on the chosen outfit direction.
Avoid presenting dependent suggestions as unrelated requirements.
rules.styling_tip: Agar suggestion A ki wajah se suggestion B hai, dono ka connection clear rakho.

rules.name: outfit_recommendation_minimum_disruption
rules.guideline: When the existing outfit is functional, prefer changes that improve it without unnecessarily replacing multiple garments.
recommendations: Identify whether one small change can solve the visible issue.
Avoid replacing several pieces when a simpler adjustment works.
Preserve successful parts of the existing combination.
rules.styling_tip: Har problem ka solution poora outfit change karna nahi hota.

rules.name: outfit_recommendation_explanation_length
rules.guideline: The explanation should contain enough reasoning to make the recommendation understandable without adding unnecessary detail.
recommendations: State the recommended change clearly.
Give the main styling reason behind it.
Avoid long explanations for simple outfit adjustments.
rules.styling_tip: Recommendation + short reason = clear AI styling advice.

rules.name: outfit_recommendation_choice_preservation
rules.guideline: When several valid styling directions exist, the AI should present meaningful alternatives instead of unnecessarily forcing one styling direction.
recommendations: Offer alternatives when different choices satisfy the same goal.
Explain the main difference between the available directions.
Let the user choose based on personal preference when no option is objectively required.
rules.styling_tip: Jab 2 valid options hain, user ko meaningful choice dena better hai.

rules.name: outfit_missing_context_handling
rules.guideline: When an important styling context is missing, the AI should avoid making assumptions that could materially change the recommendation.
recommendations: Identify whether occasion, weather or styling goal is essential to the decision.
Ask for the missing context when it would significantly change the advice.
Give a general observation only when clarification is not necessary.
rules.styling_tip: Important context missing ho to unnecessary assumption ke bajaye clarification lena better hai.

rules.name: outfit_request_scope_control
rules.guideline: The AI should keep recommendations within the styling area requested by the user unless an additional issue directly affects the requested result.
recommendations: Do not add unrelated grooming or lifestyle advice to a clothing request.
Keep the response focused on the user's stated styling problem.
Mention an additional factor only when it materially affects the outfit recommendation.
rules.styling_tip: User ne outfit poocha hai to unnecessary unrelated advice se response ko overload mat karo.

rules.name: outfit_explicit_constraint_respect
rules.guideline: Explicit user constraints should be treated as hard requirements unless they conflict with safety or make the requested styling impossible.
recommendations: Respect instructions such as keeping a specific garment unchanged.
Do not replace a requested item without explaining why it is necessary.
Build remaining recommendations around the user's stated constraints.
rules.styling_tip: User ne kisi piece ko fixed rakha hai to recommendation us constraint ke around banao.

rules.name: outfit_observation_vs_recommendation_separation
rules.guideline: The AI should clearly distinguish what is observed in the outfit from what it recommends changing.
recommendations: Describe visible outfit characteristics before proposing modifications.
Do not present a styling preference as an observed fact.
Use clear language when moving from analysis to recommendation.
rules.styling_tip: Pehle batao image mein kya hai, phir batao kya change karna hai.

rules.name: outfit_unnecessary_assumption_control
rules.guideline: The AI should avoid inferring personal preferences, wardrobe ownership or intended style when the user has not provided enough evidence.
recommendations: Do not assume the user prefers a particular fashion aesthetic.
Do not assume ownership of suggested garments.
Base personalization on stated preferences or visible evidence.
rules.styling_tip: Personal preference ya wardrobe ke baare mein bina evidence ke assumption mat karo.

rules.name: outfit_recommendation_feasibility
rules.guideline: Recommendations should be realistically achievable with normal styling adjustments or commonly available clothing options.
recommendations: Prefer practical changes over highly specialized alterations.
Do not recommend changes that require unrealistic garment modifications.
When tailoring is necessary, clearly identify it as an alteration.
rules.styling_tip: AI ki advice real life mein easily execute ho sake, ye important hai.

rules.name: outfit_recommendation_effort
rules.guideline: The AI should consider the effort required for a styling change when simpler alternatives can achieve a similar result.
recommendations: Prefer easy adjustments when they provide a similar visual improvement.
Reserve complex styling changes for cases where they offer a meaningful benefit.
Do not increase styling effort without a clear reason.
rules.styling_tip: Same result easy adjustment se mil raha hai to unnecessarily complicated solution mat do.

rules.name: outfit_recommendation_reversibility
rules.guideline: When two changes provide similar benefits, prefer the one that can be easily reversed.
recommendations: Prefer temporary styling adjustments before permanent garment alterations.
Use removable accessories when testing a new style direction.
Suggest permanent changes only when they provide a clear advantage.
rules.styling_tip: Pehle reversible change try karna safer hota hai, permanent alteration baad mein.

rules.name: outfit_recommendation_testability
rules.guideline: Styling suggestions should be easy for the user to test and visually compare when practical.
recommendations: Suggest one clear change at a time when the result can be compared.
Use before-and-after comparison for significant styling adjustments.
Avoid changing many variables simultaneously when testing a specific idea.
rules.styling_tip: Ek baar mein ek major change test karoge to pata chalega actual improvement kiski wajah se hua.

rules.name: outfit_recommendation_maintenance_burden
rules.guideline: When styling alternatives look similar, consider whether one requires substantially more maintenance to keep the intended appearance.
recommendations: Prefer lower-maintenance options when visual results are otherwise comparable.
Consider frequent ironing, cleaning or adjustment requirements.
Mention higher maintenance when it is an important practical tradeoff.
rules.styling_tip: Similar look mein jo option maintain karna easy ho, uski practical value zyada ho sakti hai.

rules.name: outfit_single_piece_transformation
rules.guideline: A versatile outfit can often be shifted toward a different style direction by changing one strategically selected piece.
recommendations: Identify the piece with the strongest influence on the outfit's overall character.
Use that piece to shift the outfit when practical.
Prefer targeted changes over rebuilding the entire combination.
rules.styling_tip: Kabhi-kabhi sirf footwear ya outer layer change karke poora vibe shift ho sakta hai.

rules.name: outfit_base_and_accent_separation
rules.guideline: A stable outfit base should remain distinguishable from temporary accent elements used to change its character.
recommendations: Identify core garments separately from optional accents.
Use accessories or outer layers as accents when appropriate.
Ensure the outfit still works when the accent element is removed.
rules.styling_tip: Core outfit aur accent piece ko mentally separate karke evaluate karo.

rules.name: outfit_style_direction_shift
rules.guideline: When changing an outfit from one style direction to another, the transition should happen through compatible elements rather than unrelated replacements.
recommendations: Identify which garment currently defines the style direction.
Change supporting elements that naturally influence that direction.
Preserve compatible pieces instead of replacing everything.
rules.styling_tip: Casual se smart-casual shift karna ho to pehle style-defining piece identify karo.

rules.name: outfit_optional_element_evaluation
rules.guideline: Optional accessories or layers should improve the intended outfit rather than being added simply because space is available.
recommendations: Evaluate whether each optional element adds function or visual value.
Remove an element when it creates unnecessary complexity.
Keep the base outfit complete without depending on optional additions.
rules.styling_tip: Har outfit ko accessory ki zarurat nahi hoti; pehle dekho actual value add ho rahi hai ya nahi.

rules.name: outfit_alternative_equivalence
rules.guideline: Different garments can provide a similar styling function, so recommendations should focus on the required role rather than one exact item.
recommendations: Identify the function required from the replacement piece.
Offer equivalent garment categories when the exact item is unavailable.
Preserve the intended silhouette, formality or colour relationship when substituting.
rules.styling_tip: Exact item na mile to uska styling role identify karke equivalent option suggest karo.

rules.name: outfit_substitution_role_matching
rules.guideline: When replacing a garment, the replacement should perform the same visual or functional role as the original piece.
recommendations: Match the replacement's purpose before considering minor design differences.
Preserve the outfit's required level of coverage, structure or utility.
Re-evaluate the complete outfit after substitution.
rules.styling_tip: Replacement sirf similar dikhna nahi chahiye, uska role bhi same hona chahiye.

rules.name: outfit_substitution_chain_control
rules.guideline: Replacing one garment can require secondary adjustments, but the AI should avoid creating an unnecessary chain of changes.
recommendations: Check whether the replacement affects other outfit elements.
Recommend only secondary changes that are actually required.
Stop the change chain once the outfit remains coherent.
rules.styling_tip: Ek replacement ke baad 4 aur changes automatically mat suggest karo; sirf necessary changes rakho.

rules.name: outfit_style_goal_tradeoff_visibility
rules.guideline: When a styling change improves one goal but reduces another, the tradeoff should be made clear.
recommendations: Identify the benefit and the potential compromise.
Do not present a tradeoff-heavy change as universally beneficial.
Let the user choose when both outcomes are reasonable.
rules.styling_tip: Ek change se ek benefit aur ek compromise ho raha hai to dono clearly batao.

rules.name: outfit_recommendation_context_switch
rules.guideline: A recommendation should be reconsidered when the user's context changes significantly, even if the outfit itself remains unchanged.
recommendations: Re-evaluate advice when the occasion, weather or activity changes.
Do not carry a context-specific recommendation into a different setting automatically.
Preserve useful garment observations while updating the recommendation.
rules.styling_tip: Same outfit ho sakta hai, lekin occasion change hote hi recommendation bhi change ho sakti hai.

rules.name: outfit_recommendation_stopping_condition
rules.guideline: Once the stated styling problem has been adequately addressed, the AI should avoid adding unnecessary additional changes.
recommendations: Check whether the user's main issue is already solved.
Do not continue modifying unrelated outfit elements.
Keep optional suggestions clearly separate from required changes.
rules.styling_tip: Problem solve ho gaya to AI ko unnecessary 'aur ye bhi change karo' mode mein nahi jaana chahiye.

rules.name: outfit_comparison_same_goal
rules.guideline: When comparing two outfits, evaluate both against the same stated goal rather than changing the evaluation criteria between them.
recommendations: Use identical criteria when comparing alternative outfits.
Consider the user's stated occasion and styling objective.
Explain differences using observable outfit characteristics.
rules.styling_tip: Do outfits compare karte waqt dono ko same criteria par judge karo.

rules.name: outfit_comparison_attribute_isolation
rules.guideline: When two outfits differ in several areas, identify which specific attributes create the meaningful difference.
recommendations: Separate colour, fit, footwear and accessory differences.
Avoid attributing the entire visual difference to one attribute without evidence.
Mention the most relevant distinguishing factors.
rules.styling_tip: Difference sirf colour ki hai ya fit/footwear bhi change hai, separately identify karo.

rules.name: outfit_comparison_context_consistency
rules.guideline: Outfit comparisons should use the same context, image conditions or available information whenever possible.
recommendations: Account for different lighting or camera angles before comparing colours.
Avoid treating different image conditions as actual outfit differences.
Use only comparable visual evidence for direct comparisons.
rules.styling_tip: Different lighting mein colour difference ko actual outfit difference mat samjho.

rules.name: outfit_comparison_change_count
rules.guideline: When comparing modified versions of an outfit, track how many variables changed before attributing the result to a specific change.
recommendations: Identify all meaningful modifications between versions.
Avoid claiming one change caused the improvement when several changes occurred.
Use controlled comparisons when possible.
rules.styling_tip: Agar 3 cheezein change hui hain, improvement ka credit sirf ek change ko mat do.

rules.name: outfit_comparison_user_preference_signal
rules.guideline: When the user expresses a preference between outfit options, future comparisons should account for that stated preference without treating it as a universal fashion rule.
recommendations: Use explicit user preferences for future personalization.
Keep personal preference separate from general styling principles.
Do not assume the preference applies to every outfit.
rules.styling_tip: User ko relaxed fit pasand hai to future advice mein consider karo, but har outfit par blindly apply mat karo.

rules.name: outfit_transformation_baseline
rules.guideline: Before recommending an outfit transformation, establish which existing elements are already working and should be preserved.
recommendations: Identify successful garments before suggesting replacements.
Keep compatible elements unchanged when possible.
Use the existing outfit as the baseline for transformation.
rules.styling_tip: Transformation ka matlab poora outfit replace karna nahi; jo sahi hai usse preserve karo.

rules.name: outfit_transformation_direction
rules.guideline: A transformation should have a clear target direction so each suggested change contributes toward the intended final appearance.
recommendations: Define the target style direction before modifying multiple pieces.
Reject changes that move the outfit away from the target.
Keep each major modification connected to the desired result.
rules.styling_tip: Pehle target vibe decide karo, phir har change ko us direction mein rakho.

rules.name: outfit_transformation_stepwise_change
rules.guideline: Complex outfit transformations should be evaluated step by step so the effect of each major change remains understandable.
recommendations: Assess the base outfit before making the first change.
Re-evaluate after each significant modification.
Stop adding changes when the target appearance is achieved.
rules.styling_tip: Major transformation ko step-by-step evaluate karo instead of changing everything blindly.

rules.name: outfit_transformation_identity_preservation
rules.guideline: A transformed outfit should retain some of its original character unless the user explicitly wants a completely different style.
recommendations: Preserve compatible signature elements during moderate transformations.
Change the strongest style-defining elements only when necessary.
Treat complete style replacement as a separate transformation goal.
rules.styling_tip: Style upgrade karte waqt original outfit ki identity ko unnecessarily erase mat karo.

rules.name: outfit_transformation_result_check
rules.guideline: After proposing multiple changes, the AI should evaluate the resulting combination as a complete outfit rather than judging each change separately.
recommendations: Check the final colour, silhouette and formality relationship.
Remove a change if the combined result creates a new issue.
Base the final recommendation on the transformed outfit as a whole.
rules.styling_tip: Har individual change sahi ho sakta hai, but final combination bhi separately check karna zaroori hai.

rules.name: outfit_garment_occurence_check
rules.guideline: The AI should verify that a suspected garment feature appears consistently enough before treating it as an actual design characteristic.
recommendations: Do not identify a single ambiguous shape as a garment feature.
Look for repeated or connected visual evidence.
Keep the attribute general when the evidence is insufficient.
rules.styling_tip: Ek random shape ko pocket, pleat ya design detail maan lene se pehle verify karo.

rules.name: outfit_garment_category_boundary
rules.guideline: The AI should distinguish between closely related garment categories before applying category-specific styling rules.
recommendations: Separate shirts, overshirts and lightweight jackets when their construction allows identification.
Do not apply a category-specific rule when the garment category is uncertain.
Use broader terminology when the available evidence does not support a precise category.
rules.styling_tip: Shirt aur overshirt jaise similar pieces ko correctly classify karke hi specific rule apply karo.

rules.name: outfit_garment_layer_count
rules.guideline: The AI should determine the actual number of visible worn layers before making layering recommendations.
recommendations: Count distinct worn layers rather than visible fabric sections.
Do not count folds or overlapping parts of the same garment as separate layers.
Adjust layering advice according to the confirmed layer count.
rules.styling_tip: Ek hi garment ke folds ko multiple layers count mat karo.

rules.name: outfit_garment_occurence_across_views
rules.guideline: When multiple views are available, a garment characteristic should be treated as reliable when it remains identifiable across relevant angles.
recommendations: Use front and side views to confirm construction details when available.
Give less weight to details visible from only one ambiguous angle.
Prefer consistent characteristics across views.
rules.styling_tip: Multiple angles mein same detail confirm ho to uski identification zyada reliable hoti hai.

rules.name: outfit_garment_category_confidence
rules.guideline: The specificity of styling advice should match the confidence of the identified garment category.
recommendations: Use precise category-specific advice when the garment is clearly identifiable.
Use broader advice when the category is ambiguous.
Do not create false precision from uncertain visual evidence.
rules.styling_tip: Category jitni clear hogi, recommendation utni specific rakho.

rules.name: outfit_shoe_toe_shape_coordination
rules.guideline: The visual shape of footwear toe boxes should complement the overall silhouette of the outfit.
recommendations: Use sleek toe shapes with streamlined outfits.
Use broader or rounded toe shapes when the outfit has a relaxed visual structure.
Avoid pairing strongly narrow footwear with extremely relaxed silhouettes when it creates a visual mismatch.
rules.styling_tip: Shoe ka toe shape outfit ki overall silhouette ke saath visually match hona chahiye.

rules.name: outfit_shoe_upper_visual_weight
rules.guideline: The visual bulk of the footwear upper should remain proportionate to the rest of the outfit.
recommendations: Use visually substantial footwear with heavier relaxed outfits.
Use cleaner footwear with lightweight and streamlined outfits.
Avoid letting an extremely bulky shoe visually overpower an otherwise minimal outfit.
rules.styling_tip: Heavy outfit ke saath substantial shoes aur clean outfit ke saath lighter-looking shoes better balance create karte hain.

rules.name: outfit_socks_visual_transition
rules.guideline: When socks are visible, their visual transition between trousers and footwear should appear intentional.
recommendations: Use sock colours that connect naturally with either the trousers or footwear.
Avoid an accidental-looking high-contrast sock break unless it is intentional.
Consider sock height when a large portion of the ankle area is visible.
rules.styling_tip: Visible socks ko trousers aur shoes ke beech intentional bridge ki tarah use karo.

rules.name: outfit_footwear_surface_finish
rules.guideline: The surface finish of footwear should support the overall finish level of the outfit.
recommendations: Pair polished footwear finishes with outfits containing refined surfaces.
Use matte or textured footwear when the outfit has a casual surface character.
Avoid an unnecessarily glossy shoe when the rest of the outfit is strongly casual.
rules.styling_tip: Shoe ka shine ya matte finish outfit ke overall finish level ko support kare.

rules.name: outfit_footwear_detail_density
rules.guideline: The amount of visible detail on footwear should be balanced against the visual simplicity or complexity of the outfit.
recommendations: Use simpler footwear when the outfit already contains multiple visual details.
Detailed footwear can work as an accent with otherwise restrained outfits.
Avoid combining highly detailed footwear with excessive competing details.
rules.styling_tip: Outfit already detailed hai to footwear clean rakho; simple outfit mein detailed shoes accent ban sakte hain.

rules.name: outfit_collar_point_visibility
rules.guideline: The visible amount and direction of a shirt collar should work naturally with the neckline and opening of the outer layer.
recommendations: Keep collar points visible when they are intended to frame the neckline.
Avoid excessive collar exposure when it competes with the outer layer.
For open outer layers, maintain a deliberate collar position.
rules.styling_tip: Collar ko naturally visible rakho, lekin outer layer ke neckline ko overpower na karne do.

rules.name: outfit_button_visibility_balance
rules.guideline: Visible garment buttons should contribute to the intended styling rather than create accidental visual distraction.
recommendations: Keep visible buttons consistent with the garment's styling direction.
Avoid unnecessarily exposing many buttons when a cleaner appearance is intended.
Use button visibility deliberately in open-shirt or layered looks.
rules.styling_tip: Buttons kitne visible hain, ye overall look ko casual ya refined feel de sakta hai.

rules.name: outfit_hoodie_drawstring_management
rules.guideline: Hoodie drawstrings should be positioned consistently so they do not create unintended visual imbalance around the chest area.
recommendations: Keep both drawstrings reasonably balanced when they are visible.
Avoid one string hanging substantially lower without intentional styling.
Consider drawstring visibility when the outfit already has strong chest-level details.
rules.styling_tip: Hoodie strings ko balanced rakho, especially jab chest area minimal ho.

rules.name: outfit_sleeve_roll_consistency
rules.guideline: When sleeves are intentionally rolled, the roll height and structure should support a deliberate appearance.
recommendations: Keep both rolled sleeves reasonably similar when symmetry is intended.
Use a consistent roll width rather than random uneven folds.
Avoid excessive rolling that changes the perceived sleeve proportion.
rules.styling_tip: Sleeves roll karo to dono sides ka roll clean aur intentional rakho.

rules.name: outfit_cuff_exposure_control
rules.guideline: When a layered sleeve exposes an inner cuff, the visible cuff amount should remain proportionate to the outer sleeve.
recommendations: Use a small controlled cuff exposure for a refined layered appearance.
Avoid excessive inner-cuff exposure that visually shortens the outer sleeve.
Match cuff exposure on both arms when symmetry is intended.
rules.styling_tip: Inner cuff thoda visible rakho; zyada exposure sleeve ko visually chhota dikha sakta hai.

rules.name: outfit_shirt_collar_opening
rules.guideline: The number of open shirt buttons should create a balanced neckline relative to the outfit's overall formality.
recommendations: Keep fewer buttons open for refined or formal looks.
A slightly deeper opening can work with relaxed casual styling.
Avoid an excessively deep opening when the rest of the outfit is conservative.
rules.styling_tip: Shirt kitna open hai, usse look ka formality level directly affect hota hai.

rules.name: outfit_tshirt_sleeve_orientation
rules.guideline: The natural orientation of a T-shirt sleeve should support the intended shoulder and arm silhouette.
recommendations: Keep sleeves sitting naturally around the upper arm.
Avoid styling that causes one sleeve to appear unintentionally twisted.
For relaxed fits, allow natural sleeve drop without excessive manipulation.
rules.styling_tip: T-shirt sleeve ko unnecessarily twist ya fold karne ke bajay natural fall maintain karo.

rules.name: outfit_trouser_hem_orientation
rules.guideline: The orientation of a trouser hem around the footwear should remain visually controlled.
recommendations: Keep the hem sitting consistently around the shoe.
Avoid excessive twisting that makes one trouser leg look visually different.
Allow natural stacking only when it suits the trouser silhouette.
rules.styling_tip: Trouser hem shoe ke around clean fall kare; unnecessary twisting look ko messy bana sakta hai.

rules.name: outfit_shirt_collar_layer_clearance
rules.guideline: A shirt collar should have enough visual clearance from nearby layers to remain intentionally structured.
recommendations: Avoid trapping the collar awkwardly beneath a tight outer neckline.
Maintain clear separation when the collar is meant to be visible.
Use a flatter collar treatment when the outer layer naturally compresses the neckline.
rules.styling_tip: Outer layer ke neckline mein collar ko awkwardly दबने mat do.

rules.name: outfit_garment_hem_curl_control
rules.guideline: A naturally curling garment hem should be evaluated separately from intentional styling adjustments.
recommendations: Do not interpret fabric curling as intentional tucking or folding.
If the curl changes the apparent garment length, account for the distortion.
Prefer the garment's underlying silhouette when making fit recommendations.
rules.styling_tip: T-shirt ya knit ka naturally curl hua hem intentional tuck samajhkar recommendation mat do.

rules.name: outfit_pattern_orientation
rules.guideline: The direction of stripes, checks, or repeated patterns can influence the perceived visual direction of a garment.
recommendations: Use vertical patterns when a more elongated visual direction is desired.
Use horizontal patterns when a broader visual impression supports the outfit.
Consider pattern direction together with the garment's existing silhouette.
rules.styling_tip: Pattern ki direction bhi garment ke visual shape ko affect kar sakti hai.

rules.name: outfit_pattern_seam_alignment
rules.guideline: Patterns should align naturally across major garment seams when the design is intended to appear continuous.
recommendations: Check pattern continuity across front panels and major seams.
Do not mistake intentional pattern breaks for poor styling.
When pattern alignment is clearly disrupted, keep the styling recommendation focused on the overall garment rather than the isolated seam.
rules.styling_tip: Checks ya stripes seam par kaise meet ho rahe hain, garment ki visual quality ko affect karte hain.

rules.name: outfit_print_placement_balance
rules.guideline: A graphic or print's placement should be evaluated according to where it sits on the garment rather than only its size.
recommendations: Consider whether the print sits near the chest, waist, or lower body.
Avoid treating identical print sizes as visually identical when their placement differs.
Use placement to understand where visual attention is naturally drawn.
rules.styling_tip: Print ka size hi nahi, woh garment par exactly kahan placed hai ye bhi important hai.

rules.name: outfit_logo_orientation
rules.guideline: The orientation and positioning of visible logos should remain visually intentional within the garment.
recommendations: Check whether the logo sits naturally relative to the garment surface.
Avoid treating distorted or folded logos as evidence of an unusual garment design.
Consider logo placement when assessing visual balance.
rules.styling_tip: Fold ki wajah se distorted logo ko actual design feature mat samjho.

rules.name: outfit_graphic_scale_by_garment_area
rules.guideline: The perceived size of a graphic should be evaluated relative to the visible garment area, not only its absolute dimensions.
recommendations: A medium graphic can appear dominant on a small visible garment area.
A large graphic can appear less dominant on a broad garment surface.
Judge graphic impact using both graphic size and available garment space.
rules.styling_tip: Graphic kitna bada hai se zyada, garment ke visible area ke comparison mein kitna bada hai ye dekho.

rules.name: outfit_shirt_collar_symmetry
rules.guideline: When a shirt collar is intended to appear symmetrical, both collar sides should create a visually balanced frame around the neckline.
recommendations: Check both collar sides before interpreting an uneven appearance as a garment defect.
Natural movement can temporarily change collar symmetry.
Base styling advice on the intended collar structure rather than a temporary shift.
rules.styling_tip: Collar ki temporary unevenness ko actual fit problem mat samjho.

rules.name: outfit_zipper_direction
rules.guideline: The visible direction and position of a zipper should be interpreted according to the garment's construction and wearing state.
recommendations: Distinguish between a partially opened zipper and a naturally offset garment opening.
Do not interpret zipper position alone as evidence of an asymmetric garment.
Consider the garment's full front structure before making styling recommendations.
rules.styling_tip: Zipper ki position ko garment ki complete front construction ke context mein dekho.

rules.name: outfit_shirt_button_alignment
rules.guideline: A shirt's visible button line should be interpreted according to the garment's natural front alignment.
recommendations: Check whether the shirt is being worn straight before judging button alignment.
Do not treat temporary fabric movement as permanent construction asymmetry.
Use the underlying center line when evaluating the shirt's overall appearance.
rules.styling_tip: Shirt thoda twisted ho to button line ko actual construction issue mat maan lena.

rules.name: outfit_outerwear_opening_width
rules.guideline: The visible width of an open outerwear front influences how much of the inner outfit becomes part of the visual composition.
recommendations: A wider opening reveals more of the inner layer and increases its visual contribution.
A narrower opening keeps more attention on the outer layer.
Adjust inner-layer styling according to the visible opening width.
rules.styling_tip: Jacket/overshirt kitna open hai, usse andar wali layer kitni prominent dikhegi.

rules.name: outfit_garment_front_overlap
rules.guideline: When two garment fronts overlap, the visible overlap amount should be considered when evaluating the layered appearance.
recommendations: Small overlap can keep layered garments visually light.
Greater overlap can make the outer garment appear more dominant.
Do not confuse front overlap with garment length.
rules.styling_tip: Layered pieces ka front overlap bhi decide karta hai ki outer layer kitni dominant lagegi.

rules.name: outfit_garment_texture_direction
rules.guideline: Directional texture such as ribbing, corduroy wales, or brushed grain can influence how a garment visually reads.
recommendations: Consider the direction of visible texture when evaluating the garment's appearance.
Do not confuse directional texture with printed patterns.
Use texture direction as a secondary visual factor after identifying the garment silhouette.
rules.styling_tip: Ribbing ya corduroy ki texture direction bhi garment ke visual flow ko affect kar sakti hai.

rules.name: outfit_garment_rib_visibility
rules.guideline: Visible ribbed construction can change the perceived texture and visual density of a garment.
recommendations: Treat clearly visible ribbing as a texture characteristic rather than a print.
Use finer ribbing for a more subtle surface appearance.
Consider stronger ribbing when evaluating the visual weight of knit or stretch garments.
rules.styling_tip: Ribbed texture garment ko visually zyada textured aur dense dikha sakti hai.

rules.name: outfit_garment_piping_visibility
rules.guideline: Visible piping or narrow edge detailing can create directional lines that influence garment perception.
recommendations: Treat piping as a structural detail rather than a large graphic element.
Consider whether the piping reinforces or interrupts the garment's main lines.
Avoid giving excessive visual importance to very subtle piping.
rules.styling_tip: Piping ek subtle structural detail hai; ise graphic print ki tarah treat mat karo.

rules.name: outfit_garment_panel_transition
rules.guideline: Changes between garment panels can create visual divisions that should be distinguished from separate layers.
recommendations: Identify panel construction before counting visible garment layers.
Do not interpret colour or texture changes between panels as different garments.
Use the complete garment construction when evaluating its silhouette.
rules.styling_tip: Ek garment ke alag panels ko separate layers samajhne ki mistake mat karo.

rules.name: outfit_garment_trim_proportion
rules.guideline: Contrasting trims such as binding, edging, or narrow borders should remain proportionate to the garment's overall visual scale.
recommendations: Use subtle trims when the garment already has strong visual elements.
Allow stronger trims to act as deliberate design accents on simpler garments.
Evaluate trim width relative to the garment rather than in isolation.
rules.styling_tip: Trim ya border ki width garment ke overall scale ke according honi chahiye.

rules.name: outfit_garment_placket_width
rules.guideline: The width of a visible garment placket can influence the perceived structure and visual weight around the center front.
recommendations: Use narrower plackets for visually cleaner front structures.
Broader plackets can support garments with stronger construction details.
Evaluate placket width together with the garment's overall front design.
rules.styling_tip: Placket ki width center front ko visually clean ya structured bana sakti hai.

rules.name: outfit_garment_shoulder_drop_consistency
rules.guideline: The visible shoulder drop should be interpreted consistently across both sides when assessing a relaxed garment silhouette.
recommendations: Compare both shoulders before judging the garment as intentionally asymmetric.
Natural pose can make one shoulder appear lower.
Use the garment's overall shoulder line rather than a single side.
rules.styling_tip: Pose ki wajah se ek shoulder low lag sakta hai, isliye dono sides compare karo.

rules.name: outfit_garment_side_panel_visibility
rules.guideline: Visible side panels can change how wide or narrow a garment appears from a particular viewing angle.
recommendations: Consider side-panel visibility when interpreting the garment's apparent width.
Do not judge the complete silhouette from a heavily angled view alone.
Use front and side information when available.
rules.styling_tip: Side panel visible hone se garment front view mein wider ya narrower appear ho sakta hai.

rules.name: outfit_garment_edge_stability
rules.guideline: Garment edges should be evaluated for whether their apparent shape comes from construction or temporary fabric movement.
recommendations: Distinguish stable garment edges from edges changed by movement.
Do not use a temporarily displaced hem or edge as the primary fit reference.
Prioritize repeated structural evidence when available.
rules.styling_tip: Movement se displaced edge ko actual garment shape samajhkar fit judge mat karo.

rules.name: outfit_garment_support_structure
rules.guideline: Structured garments should be evaluated for the visible support provided by construction elements such as interfacing or reinforced areas.
recommendations: Recognize reinforced areas when they visibly affect garment shape.
Do not apply soft-garment styling assumptions to strongly structured pieces.
Consider structural support when evaluating how the garment holds its intended form.
rules.styling_tip: Structured jacket/shirt ki shape sirf fabric se nahi, internal support se bhi maintain ho sakti hai.

rules.name: outfit_garment_wear_direction
rules.guideline: The direction in which a garment naturally shifts during wear can affect its visible silhouette.
recommendations: Distinguish natural garment movement from the intended static silhouette.
Do not recommend resizing based only on temporary garment displacement.
Use stable areas of the garment as stronger fit references.
rules.styling_tip: Garment body par naturally shift ho raha ho to usse direct fit problem mat samjho.

rules.name: outfit_garment_tension_distribution
rules.guideline: Visible fabric tension can indicate where a garment is experiencing pressure during wear.
recommendations: Look for repeated tension lines around movement areas.
Distinguish temporary tension caused by pose from persistent tension caused by fit.
Use tension patterns together with the garment's overall silhouette.
rules.styling_tip: Chest, waist ya hips par repeated tension lines fit ke useful clues ho sakte hain.

rules.name: outfit_garment_resting_position
rules.guideline: A garment's resting position on the body should be considered before evaluating its apparent fit or proportion.
recommendations: Identify whether the garment is naturally sitting at the waist, hips, or shoulders.
Do not compare proportions before accounting for the garment's resting position.
Use the garment's actual worn position for styling analysis.
rules.styling_tip: Garment body par exactly kahan rest kar raha hai, pehle ye identify karo.

rules.name: outfit_garment_pull_direction
rules.guideline: The direction of visible fabric pulls can reveal how body movement or garment interaction is affecting the appearance.
recommendations: Identify whether pulls originate from movement or contact with another garment.
Do not interpret isolated diagonal pulls as permanent construction problems.
Consider repeated pull direction when assessing worn fit.
rules.styling_tip: Fabric kis direction mein pull ho raha hai, usse movement aur garment interaction samajhne mein help milti hai.

rules.name: outfit_garment_contact_tension
rules.guideline: Where two garments touch or press against each other can influence visible folds and tension.
recommendations: Separate garment-contact effects from the underlying fit of each piece.
Do not judge one garment independently when another layer is visibly compressing it.
Consider contact areas around the waist, shoulders, and sleeves.
rules.styling_tip: Do layers ek-dusre ko press kar rahe hain to resulting folds ko fit issue mat maan lena.

rules.name: outfit_accessory_attachment_visibility
rules.guideline: Accessories should be evaluated according to how clearly their attachment or wearing position is visible in the outfit.
recommendations: Confirm that an accessory is actually being worn before recommending coordination around it.
Do not interpret partially hidden accessories as multiple accessories.
Use clearly visible accessories as stronger styling signals.
rules.styling_tip: Accessory actually worn hai ya sirf partially visible hai, pehle confirm karo.

rules.name: outfit_accessory_position_consistency
rules.guideline: The wearing position of an accessory should support its intended styling role within the outfit.
recommendations: Consider whether an accessory sits at the intended body position.
Avoid judging its coordination from an unusually displaced position caused by movement.
Use the normal wearing position when making styling suggestions.
rules.styling_tip: Chain, watch ya bag ki actual wearing position ko styling signal maan kar analyse karo.

rules.name: outfit_accessory_function_signal
rules.guideline: An accessory's apparent function can influence whether it should be treated as a styling element or a practical item.
recommendations: Distinguish functional items from purely decorative accessories when identifiable.
Do not recommend removing a practical item solely because it adds visual detail.
Balance functional requirements with the intended outfit appearance.
rules.styling_tip: Har visible item fashion accessory nahi hota; practical purpose bhi consider karo.

rules.name: outfit_garment_usage_orientation
rules.guideline: Some garments have an intended front, back, or orientation that should be established before styling analysis.
recommendations: Use identifiable closures, labels, or construction cues to establish orientation.
Do not assume orientation solely from the visible shape.
If orientation remains uncertain, avoid orientation-dependent recommendations.
rules.styling_tip: Garment front/back unclear ho to orientation-based styling advice mat do.

rules.name: outfit_garment_intended_opening
rules.guideline: The intended opening of a garment should be distinguished from an opening created temporarily through movement or positioning.
recommendations: Identify whether an opening is part of the garment design or simply caused by movement.
Do not recommend styling changes based on temporary gaps alone.
Use repeated visual evidence when determining the intended opening.
rules.styling_tip: Temporary gap ko garment ka intentional opening samajhne se recommendation galat ho sakti hai.

rules.name: outfit_garment_visual_age
rules.guideline: The apparent age or wear character of garments should be considered when combining pieces with noticeably different visual age.
recommendations: Avoid unnecessary mismatch between heavily worn pieces and very pristine pieces when a cohesive appearance is intended.
Allow intentional vintage or distressed combinations when the overall style supports them.
Evaluate the visible wear character of the complete outfit.
rules.styling_tip: Ek bahut worn piece ko bilkul pristine pieces ke saath pair karte waqt overall vibe check karo.

rules.name: outfit_garment_formality_age
rules.guideline: The perceived age character of a garment's design can influence how formal or casual the complete outfit feels.
recommendations: Classic mature-looking pieces can support refined combinations.
Youth-oriented casual details can shift an otherwise formal outfit toward casual styling.
Judge the combined design language rather than the garment's age alone.
rules.styling_tip: Garment ka design character bhi overall outfit ko mature, youthful, casual ya refined feel de sakta hai.

rules.name: outfit_garment_cultural_signal
rules.guideline: Garments can carry cultural or regional visual signals that should be considered before applying generic styling assumptions.
recommendations: Recognize traditional garment characteristics when clearly visible.
Do not apply Western dress-code assumptions to culturally specific garments without context.
Consider the intended cultural setting when recommending combinations.
rules.styling_tip: Kurta, bandhgala ya traditional pieces ko generic Western styling rules se judge mat karo.

rules.name: outfit_garment_social_signal
rules.guideline: Certain garment details can communicate a stronger social or stylistic signal than their physical size suggests.
recommendations: Consider recognizable style signals such as varsity, workwear, formal tailoring, or streetwear details.
Use the complete outfit context before assigning a style direction.
Do not let one recognizable detail completely override the rest of the outfit.
rules.styling_tip: Ek small detail bhi outfit ko streetwear, workwear ya varsity direction de sakta hai.

rules.name: outfit_style_signal_strength
rules.guideline: When multiple style signals are present, recommendations should account for their combined strength rather than treating every signal equally.
recommendations: Identify the strongest visible style signals first.
Use supporting details to reinforce the dominant direction.
Avoid combining too many unrelated strong style signals without a deliberate reason.
rules.styling_tip: Outfit mein jo style signal sabse strong hai, baaki pieces usko support karne chahiye.

rules.name: outfit_body_landmark_alignment
rules.guideline: Visible garment features should be interpreted relative to stable body landmarks such as shoulders, waist, and knees.
recommendations: Use body landmarks to understand where garment features actually sit.
Do not judge feature placement only from image coordinates.
Account for pose before interpreting unusual feature positions.
rules.styling_tip: Pocket, hem ya waistband ki position body landmarks ke relative check karo.

rules.name: outfit_body_angle_compensation
rules.guideline: Body rotation can make garment proportions appear different from their actual worn proportions.
recommendations: Use the visible body angle when interpreting garment width and length.
Avoid making precise proportion judgments from strongly rotated poses.
Prefer relatively neutral views when available.
rules.styling_tip: Body camera se rotated ho to garment width aur length visually misleading ho sakti hai.

rules.name: outfit_body_landmark_visibility
rules.guideline: Body landmarks that are hidden by garments or accessories should not be estimated with unnecessary precision.
recommendations: Use only clearly visible landmarks for precise proportion analysis.
Keep measurements approximate when key reference points are covered.
Avoid creating false body-proportion conclusions from occluded areas.
rules.styling_tip: Waist ya shoulders covered hain to AI ko exact proportion assume nahi karna chahiye.

rules.name: outfit_body_garment_boundary_ratio
rules.guideline: The visible boundary between the body and garment can help distinguish garment volume from body shape.
recommendations: Use clear garment edges as the primary reference for silhouette.
Do not interpret loose fabric as additional body width.
Avoid inferring body shape from garments with substantial volume.
rules.styling_tip: Oversized clothes mein garment volume ko body width samajhna avoid karo.

rules.name: outfit_body_pose_neutrality
rules.guideline: Styling recommendations should distinguish between the outfit's appearance in a neutral stance and changes caused by an active pose.
recommendations: Use neutral posture as the baseline for proportion analysis when available.
Do not recommend garment changes solely because of temporary pose-related distortion.
Use active poses mainly for movement and drape observations.
rules.styling_tip: Neutral pose ko fit/proportion baseline rakho; active pose ko movement analysis ke liye use karo.

rules.name: outfit_detail_material_relationship
rules.guideline: Small garment details should be interpreted together with the material they are made from because material changes their visual impact.
recommendations: Treat metal, leather, fabric, and plastic details differently when assessing visual character.
Do not judge detail prominence from size alone.
Consider material contrast when multiple details are visible.
rules.styling_tip: Same size ka detail different material mein completely different visual impact de sakta hai.

rules.name: outfit_detail_hardware_grouping
rules.guideline: Multiple visible hardware elements should be assessed as a group when they contribute to the same area of the outfit.
recommendations: Consider zippers, snaps, buckles, and metal accents together when they cluster visually.
Avoid treating every small hardware element as an independent focal point.
Keep hardware interpretation proportional to its visibility.
rules.styling_tip: Multiple metal details ek hi area mein hain to unka combined visual effect dekho.

rules.name: outfit_detail_edge_contrast
rules.guideline: The contrast between a garment detail and its surrounding fabric affects how prominently that detail is perceived.
recommendations: High-contrast details should be treated as more visually noticeable.
Low-contrast details may function as subtle texture or structure.
Evaluate detail prominence using both contrast and physical size.
rules.styling_tip: Detail ka size same ho sakta hai, lekin contrast zyada ho to woh much more noticeable lagega.

rules.name: outfit_detail_repetition_interval
rules.guideline: Repeated small details can create a visual rhythm depending on the spacing between them.
recommendations: Regularly spaced details can create a structured appearance.
Irregular spacing can create a more relaxed or visually varied impression.
Do not evaluate repeated details only by their individual size.
rules.styling_tip: Buttons, studs ya repeated details ki spacing outfit mein visual rhythm create karti hai.

rules.name: outfit_detail_scale_consistency
rules.guideline: Related garment details should maintain a visually coherent scale relative to one another.
recommendations: Large primary details can support smaller secondary details.
Avoid excessive competition between multiple similarly prominent details.
Evaluate related details as part of one design system.
rules.styling_tip: Ek garment ke related details ka scale ek coherent design language follow kare.

rules.name: outfit_garment_interaction_zone
rules.guideline: When two garments interact at a specific body area, evaluate that zone as a combined visual unit.
recommendations: Assess the waist, neckline, and sleeve junction as interaction zones when layers meet.
Consider how one garment changes the visible shape of the other.
Avoid evaluating overlapping garments completely independently.
rules.styling_tip: Jahan do garments meet karte hain, wahan unka combined effect dekho.

rules.name: outfit_garment_transition_smoothness
rules.guideline: The visual transition between adjacent garments should appear intentional rather than abruptly disconnected.
recommendations: Look for compatible changes in silhouette, texture, and visual direction.
Use a bridging element when two pieces create a harsh transition.
Do not confuse deliberate contrast with poor coordination.
rules.styling_tip: Do contrasting pieces ke beech transition intentional lagni chahiye, random nahi.

rules.name: outfit_visual_connection_distance
rules.guideline: The perceived relationship between two outfit elements can weaken as they become visually separated by distance or intervening layers.
recommendations: Directly adjacent elements usually create a stronger visual connection.
Use repeated colour, material, or shape cues to connect separated elements.
Avoid assuming distant elements automatically coordinate without supporting cues.
rules.styling_tip: Door ke elements ko connect karne ke liye colour ya material repetition helpful hoti hai.

rules.name: outfit_element_interaction_strength
rules.guideline: Not every visible outfit element interacts with the same strength; recommendations should focus on meaningful visual relationships.
recommendations: Give stronger consideration to elements that directly overlap or visually connect.
Treat isolated minor details as secondary unless they significantly affect the outfit.
Prioritize interactions that change the overall appearance.
rules.styling_tip: Har small detail ko equal importance mat do; meaningful visual interaction ko priority do.

rules.name: outfit_transition_anchor
rules.guideline: A clear visual anchor can help connect two outfit sections that otherwise feel visually separate.
recommendations: Use a belt, footwear, accessory, or repeated colour as a connecting element when appropriate.
Choose an anchor that already fits the outfit's visual language.
Avoid adding an unnecessary anchor when the outfit is already visually connected.
rules.styling_tip: Agar upper aur lower half disconnected lage, ek existing colour ya accessory ko bridge ki tarah use karo.

rules.name: outfit_detail_proximity
rules.guideline: The perceived importance of a garment detail can change depending on how close it is to other visible details.
recommendations: Treat closely grouped details as a combined visual area.
Avoid assuming separated details create the same visual effect as clustered details.
Consider proximity when assessing visual complexity.
rules.styling_tip: Paas-paass details ek combined visual cluster bana sakte hain.

rules.name: outfit_detail_isolation
rules.guideline: An isolated detail can become more noticeable because surrounding areas provide less competing information.
recommendations: Consider surrounding negative space when judging a detail's prominence.
Do not judge importance from physical size alone.
Use isolation as a secondary factor in visual analysis.
rules.styling_tip: Simple area mein chhota detail bhi zyada noticeable ho sakta hai.

rules.name: outfit_detail_density_transition
rules.guideline: A sudden change from a highly detailed area to a very plain area can influence the perceived visual flow of an outfit.
recommendations: Recognize abrupt changes in detail density between adjacent outfit zones.
Use simpler supporting pieces when a transition feels visually heavy.
Do not eliminate contrast when the difference is clearly intentional.
rules.styling_tip: Detailed upper aur completely plain lower ke beech transition ko overall flow ke context mein dekho.

rules.name: outfit_detail_alignment_axis
rules.guideline: Details that visually align along a common vertical or horizontal axis can create stronger structural organization.
recommendations: Notice alignment between pockets, closures, graphics, and other major details.
Use alignment as a supporting cue when assessing visual order.
Do not force alignment interpretations when perspective makes positions uncertain.
rules.styling_tip: Major details ek common axis follow karein to outfit more organized feel kar sakta hai.

rules.name: outfit_detail_direction_consistency
rules.guideline: Repeated directional details can reinforce a common visual flow across an outfit.
recommendations: Compare the direction of major lines and details across garments.
Use consistent directional cues when creating a streamlined appearance.
Allow intentional directional contrast when it supports the style.
rules.styling_tip: Garments ki major lines same visual direction follow karein to look more cohesive feel ho sakta hai.

rules.name: outfit_garment_armpit_clearance
rules.guideline: The space around the armpit should allow natural movement without creating excessive fabric collapse or restriction.
recommendations: Check armpit clearance when evaluating shirts, jackets, and overshirts.
Avoid judging the area from a raised-arm pose alone.
Look for consistent restriction or excess fabric in neutral posture.
rules.styling_tip: Armpit area mein natural movement ke liye enough clearance hona chahiye.

rules.name: outfit_garment_armhole_shape
rules.guideline: The shape of the armhole influences how a garment sits around the upper torso and arm.
recommendations: Consider armhole shape when assessing sleeve movement.
Do not judge sleeve fit independently from the armhole.
Use the complete upper-body structure for evaluation.
rules.styling_tip: Sleeve fit samajhne ke liye armhole ko bhi consider karo.

rules.name: outfit_sleeve_cap_shape
rules.guideline: The upper sleeve shape can influence how naturally a sleeve follows the shoulder and upper arm.
recommendations: Check whether the sleeve transitions smoothly from the shoulder.
Avoid interpreting temporary folds as permanent sleeve construction.
Compare both sleeves when symmetry is expected.
rules.styling_tip: Sleeve ka upper section shoulder se naturally flow karna chahiye.

rules.name: outfit_upper_arm_ease
rules.guideline: Adequate ease around the upper arm helps maintain the intended sleeve silhouette.
recommendations: Check for persistent horizontal pulling around the upper arm.
Avoid excessive looseness that removes the intended sleeve shape.
Consider sleeve type before judging ease.
rules.styling_tip: Upper arm par na excessive tightness ho na unnecessary extra fabric.

rules.name: outfit_forearm_ease
rules.guideline: Forearm ease should support the intended sleeve shape without creating unnecessary restriction.
recommendations: Check forearm movement when evaluating fitted sleeves.
Allow more ease for relaxed garments.
Do not apply fitted-sleeve expectations to oversized garments.
rules.styling_tip: Sleeve type ke according forearm par appropriate ease maintain karo.

rules.name: outfit_wrist_opening_proportion
rules.guideline: The sleeve opening should remain proportionate to the wrist and the visual structure of the sleeve.
recommendations: Use narrower openings for structured fitted sleeves.
Relaxed sleeves can support wider openings.
Avoid an opening that makes the sleeve appear disproportionately tight or loose.
rules.styling_tip: Wrist opening sleeve ke overall volume ke according honi chahiye.

rules.name: outfit_shirt_body_ease
rules.guideline: Shirt body ease should provide enough room for movement while preserving the intended silhouette.
recommendations: Check front and side appearance when evaluating shirt ease.
Avoid judging looseness from one temporary fold.
Match ease to the shirt's intended fit category.
rules.styling_tip: Shirt body mein movement ke liye space ho, lekin silhouette lost na ho.

rules.name: outfit_chest_ease
rules.guideline: Chest ease should allow natural movement without creating persistent pulling or excessive fabric volume.
recommendations: Check chest area in a neutral stance.
Persistent pulling can indicate insufficient ease.
Excessive chest volume can alter the intended silhouette.
rules.styling_tip: Chest area mein comfortable ease aur clean silhouette ka balance rakho.

rules.name: outfit_waist_ease
rules.guideline: Waist ease should correspond with the garment's intended fit and wearing position.
recommendations: Avoid excessive waist restriction in relaxed garments.
Structured garments can use controlled waist shaping.
Evaluate waist ease together with the garment's complete silhouette.
rules.styling_tip: Waist par ease garment ke fit type ke according hona chahiye.

rules.name: outfit_hip_ease
rules.guideline: Hip ease affects how naturally longer tops, shirts, jackets, and trousers move around the hip area.
recommendations: Check for persistent pulling around the hips.
Avoid excessive looseness that distorts the intended shape.
Consider garment length before judging hip ease.
rules.styling_tip: Hip area mein enough ease movement ke liye important hai, especially longer garments mein.

rules.name: outfit_garment_vertical_balance
rules.guideline: The distribution of garment volume from upper to lower sections should support the intended silhouette.
recommendations: Compare upper, middle, and lower garment volume.
Avoid concentrating excessive volume in one section without a deliberate reason.
Use the intended fit category as the baseline.
rules.styling_tip: Garment ka volume top-to-bottom balanced feel hona chahiye.

rules.name: outfit_garment_horizontal_balance
rules.guideline: Visual width across different garment sections should create a coherent horizontal structure.
recommendations: Compare shoulder, torso, and lower-body width where visible.
Avoid judging one horizontal section independently.
Consider silhouette direction before making adjustments.
rules.styling_tip: Shoulder se lower section tak width ka relationship coherent hona chahiye.

rules.name: outfit_torso_length_perception
rules.guideline: The apparent torso length can change depending on where garments begin and end.
recommendations: Consider visible top and bottom boundaries together.
Avoid judging torso proportion from a single garment alone.
Use layering and garment position as supporting context.
rules.styling_tip: Top aur bottom ki boundaries milkar torso ki visual length affect karti hain.

rules.name: outfit_leg_length_perception
rules.guideline: The apparent leg length can be influenced by trouser position, hem placement, and footwear relationship.
recommendations: Consider the complete lower-body composition.
Avoid making leg-proportion conclusions from footwear alone.
Use consistent visual boundaries when evaluating the silhouette.
rules.styling_tip: Trouser aur footwear ki positioning legs ki visual length ko affect kar sakti hai.

rules.name: outfit_waistline_visual_position
rules.guideline: The visible position of the waistline can influence the perceived proportions of the upper and lower body.
recommendations: Identify the actual garment waist position before judging proportions.
Consider high, mid, and low-rise garments separately.
Avoid changing proportions based only on camera angle.
rules.styling_tip: Waistline ki position upper aur lower body proportions ko visually shift kar sakti hai.

rules.name: outfit_trouser_hip_ease
rules.guideline: Trouser hip ease should provide comfortable movement while maintaining the intended leg shape.
recommendations: Check persistent pulling around the hip area.
Avoid excessive looseness that creates unnecessary bulk.
Evaluate hip ease together with the thigh and leg shape.
rules.styling_tip: Trouser hip area comfortable ho, lekin unnecessary bulk create na kare.

rules.name: outfit_trouser_thigh_ease
rules.guideline: Thigh ease should support movement while preserving the intended trouser silhouette.
recommendations: Use more ease for relaxed trouser silhouettes.
Fitted trousers require controlled but comfortable ease.
Look for persistent pulling rather than temporary movement folds.
rules.styling_tip: Thigh area mein movement ke liye enough room hona chahiye.

rules.name: outfit_trouser_calf_ease
rules.guideline: Calf ease influences how trousers fall between the knee and hem.
recommendations: Consider calf width when evaluating tapered trousers.
Avoid excessive restriction in fitted styles.
Match calf ease to the intended leg silhouette.
rules.styling_tip: Tapered trouser mein calf area ka ease overall leg shape ko affect karta hai.

rules.name: outfit_trouser_ankle_ease
rules.guideline: The space around the ankle should support the intended trouser opening without creating unwanted bunching.
recommendations: Check ankle appearance with the chosen footwear.
Avoid excessive fabric accumulation around a narrow opening.
Use the intended trouser silhouette as the reference.
rules.styling_tip: Ankle par extra bunching ho to trouser opening aur footwear dono check karo.

rules.name: outfit_trouser_leg_symmetry
rules.guideline: When both trouser legs are intended to match, their apparent silhouette should be compared before judging fit.
recommendations: Compare both legs in a neutral stance.
Account for different leg positions during movement.
Do not treat pose-induced differences as construction differences.
rules.styling_tip: Dono trouser legs ko same posture mein compare karke fit judge karo.

rules.name: outfit_trouser_front_volume
rules.guideline: The amount of fabric visible across the trouser front influences perceived lower-body volume.
recommendations: Consider front volume when comparing fitted and relaxed trousers.
Avoid confusing fabric folds with permanent excess volume.
Evaluate the front together with side and back appearance when available.
rules.styling_tip: Trouser front ka fabric volume lower-body silhouette ko visibly change kar sakta hai.

rules.name: outfit_trouser_back_volume
rules.guideline: The rear volume of trousers should support natural movement without creating unnecessary excess fabric.
recommendations: Check the back silhouette when that view is available.
Distinguish movement folds from persistent excess fabric.
Consider seat and hip structure together.
rules.styling_tip: Back side ka excess fabric aur natural movement folds ko alag identify karo.

rules.name: outfit_jacket_chest_ease
rules.guideline: Jacket chest ease should allow natural movement while maintaining the intended structured appearance.
recommendations: Check the jacket in a neutral stance.
Persistent pulling can indicate insufficient chest ease.
Excessive ease can reduce the intended structured silhouette.
rules.styling_tip: Jacket chest area comfortable ho but structure loose hokar collapse na ho.

rules.name: outfit_jacket_waist_shape
rules.guideline: The degree of waist shaping in a jacket should correspond to its intended silhouette.
recommendations: Structured jackets can use controlled waist shaping.
Relaxed jackets should retain more natural body ease.
Do not apply tailored waist expectations to intentionally relaxed outerwear.
rules.styling_tip: Tailored jacket mein controlled waist shape aur relaxed jacket mein natural ease rakho.

rules.name: outfit_jacket_hip_clearance
rules.guideline: A jacket should have sufficient clearance around the hips for natural movement and clean drape.
recommendations: Check for persistent pulling at the lower jacket area.
Avoid excessive tightness when the jacket is intended to be worn closed.
Consider jacket length when evaluating hip clearance.
rules.styling_tip: Jacket lower section hips ke around smoothly fall kare aur pull na kare.

rules.name: outfit_coat_body_ease
rules.guideline: Long coats require sufficient body ease to preserve clean drape and allow the layers underneath to function comfortably.
recommendations: Consider the layers worn underneath.
Avoid judging coat looseness without accounting for inner layers.
Maintain a clean vertical fall through the body.
rules.styling_tip: Coat ke fit ko inner layers ke saath evaluate karo.

rules.name: outfit_coat_sleeve_clearance
rules.guideline: Coat sleeves should provide enough clearance for the layers underneath without excessive bulk.
recommendations: Consider shirt, sweater, or blazer layers underneath.
Avoid overly narrow sleeves when layering is expected.
Do not interpret inner-layer folds as coat sleeve excess.
rules.styling_tip: Coat sleeve ke andar inner layers ke liye enough room hona chahiye.

rules.name: outfit_overshirt_body_ease
rules.guideline: An overshirt should maintain enough body ease to function as an outer layer without losing its intended silhouette.
recommendations: Allow more ease when the overshirt is designed for layering.
Avoid excessive looseness that makes the garment appear shapeless.
Evaluate the overshirt with its intended wearing method.
rules.styling_tip: Overshirt ko outer layer ki tarah pehna hai toh body mein layering space hona chahiye.

rules.name: outfit_cardigan_body_ease
rules.guideline: Cardigan body ease should support the intended open or closed wearing style.
recommendations: Allow additional ease when the cardigan is layered over thicker pieces.
Use cleaner ease for lightweight standalone wear.
Consider buttoned and open states separately.
rules.styling_tip: Cardigan open aur buttoned dono states mein alag fit behaviour dikha sakta hai.

rules.name: outfit_sweater_layering_ease
rules.guideline: Sweater ease should account for the thickness of garments worn underneath.
recommendations: Use more room when layering over shirts.
Avoid excessive bulk when the sweater is worn directly over the base layer.
Evaluate sleeve and body ease together.
rules.styling_tip: Sweater ka fit inner shirt ya T-shirt ke thickness ke according choose karo.

rules.name: outfit_hoodie_face_opening
rules.guideline: The face opening of a hoodie should provide a balanced frame around the head without appearing excessively tight or loose.
recommendations: Consider neckline and hood construction together.
Avoid judging the opening from a strongly tilted head position.
Use the hood's intended fit category as the baseline.
rules.styling_tip: Hoodie ka face opening head ko comfortably frame kare.

rules.name: outfit_sweatshirt_neck_opening
rules.guideline: The neckline opening of a sweatshirt should support its intended relaxed or fitted appearance.
recommendations: A cleaner opening works well with structured sweatshirts.
Relaxed sweatshirts can allow a more open neckline appearance.
Avoid excessive stretching around the neckline.
rules.styling_tip: Sweatshirt neckline na overly stretched lage na unnecessarily tight.

rules.name: outfit_kurta_chest_ease
rules.guideline: Kurta chest ease should provide comfortable movement while preserving the intended traditional or contemporary silhouette.
recommendations: Avoid excessive chest restriction.
Do not make a contemporary slim kurta unnecessarily loose.
Consider fabric drape along with chest ease.
rules.styling_tip: Kurta chest area comfortable ho aur desired silhouette maintain kare.

rules.name: outfit_kurta_hip_ease
rules.guideline: Kurta hip ease should allow natural movement without creating excessive side volume.
recommendations: Allow more ease for traditional relaxed silhouettes.
Use controlled ease for modern fitted kurtas.
Consider side openings when evaluating movement.
rules.styling_tip: Kurta hip area mein movement space aur clean fall dono maintain karo.

rules.name: outfit_kurta_body_taper
rules.guideline: The degree of taper through a kurta body should match its intended silhouette.
recommendations: Use subtle taper for contemporary styling.
Keep traditional relaxed kurtas comparatively straighter.
Avoid excessive taper that restricts movement.
rules.styling_tip: Modern kurta mein subtle taper aur traditional kurta mein straighter body zyada natural lag sakti hai.

rules.name: outfit_blazer_chest_to_waist_transition
rules.guideline: The transition from chest width to waist width should appear controlled in a tailored blazer.
recommendations: Look for a smooth progression rather than abrupt narrowing.
Avoid excessive waist suppression.
Compare the transition with the blazer's intended tailoring level.
rules.styling_tip: Blazer mein chest se waist tak smooth shaping refined silhouette create karti hai.

rules.name: outfit_blazer_hip_to_hem_transition
rules.guideline: The lower blazer shape should transition naturally from the hip area toward the hem.
recommendations: Avoid excessive narrowing near the hem.
Allow the blazer to maintain its intended structured fall.
Consider the buttoned state when evaluating the lower silhouette.
rules.styling_tip: Blazer ka lower body hips se hem tak naturally fall kare.

rules.name: outfit_shorts_leg_balance
rules.guideline: Shorts should maintain a coherent relationship between waist, thigh, and leg opening.
recommendations: Avoid an extremely narrow opening on a very relaxed short.
Avoid excessive width when a tailored short silhouette is intended.
Evaluate the complete short silhouette rather than length alone.
rules.styling_tip: Shorts mein waist se leg opening tak overall shape balanced honi chahiye.

rules.name: outfit_shorts_hip_ease
rules.guideline: Shorts require sufficient hip ease for movement while maintaining the intended casual or tailored shape.
recommendations: Check persistent pulling around the hip area.
Allow more ease for relaxed shorts.
Keep controlled ease for tailored shorts.
rules.styling_tip: Shorts hip area comfortable ho aur unnecessary bulk na create kare.

rules.name: outfit_shorts_thigh_clearance
rules.guideline: Thigh clearance in shorts should support movement and match the intended leg silhouette.
recommendations: Relaxed shorts can allow greater thigh clearance.
Tailored shorts should maintain controlled clearance.
Avoid excessive restriction during movement.
rules.styling_tip: Shorts thigh area mein enough clearance movement aur clean shape dono ke liye important hai.

rules.name: outfit_jogger_ankle_tension
rules.guideline: Jogger ankle tension should correspond to the intended cuffed silhouette without excessive compression.
recommendations: A controlled cuff should sit securely without discomfort.
Avoid excessive bunching above a tight cuff.
Evaluate cuff tension with the jogger's overall leg shape.
rules.styling_tip: Jogger cuff ankle par secure ho but excessively tight ya bunching wala na lage.

rules.name: outfit_jogger_body_ease
rules.guideline: Jogger body ease should support relaxed movement while preserving the intended athletic or casual silhouette.
recommendations: Allow functional ease through the thigh and calf.
Avoid excessive fabric that removes the intended tapered shape.
Consider the cuff when evaluating the complete leg silhouette.
rules.styling_tip: Jogger relaxed hona chahiye, lekin itna loose nahi ki tapered shape disappear ho jaye.

rules.name: outfit_track_pants_leg_balance
rules.guideline: Track pants should maintain consistent visual balance from upper leg through the lower leg.
recommendations: Avoid abrupt narrowing that makes the leg shape look disconnected.
Match taper with the intended sporty silhouette.
Consider side details without allowing them to distort the overall fit assessment.
rules.styling_tip: Track pants ka taper upper leg se lower leg tak smoothly transition kare.

rules.name: outfit_denim_waist_ease
rules.guideline: Denim waist ease should provide secure wear without excessive compression or unwanted waistband movement.
recommendations: Check whether the waistband sits securely in the intended position.
Avoid relying only on belt use to compensate for poor waist fit.
Consider the denim's stretch characteristics.
rules.styling_tip: Jeans waist secure honi chahiye bina belt par completely depend kiye.

rules.name: outfit_denim_seat_ease
rules.guideline: Denim should provide enough seat ease for movement while maintaining the intended rear silhouette.
recommendations: Look for persistent pulling when evaluating the seat.
Avoid excessive fabric that creates unnecessary rear volume.
Consider stretch denim separately from rigid denim.
rules.styling_tip: Jeans back seat area mein movement ke liye enough ease rakho.

rules.name: outfit_denim_leg_taper_consistency
rules.guideline: The taper of denim should progress consistently toward the hem when a tapered silhouette is intended.
recommendations: Avoid abrupt changes in width along the leg.
Compare upper-leg and lower-leg width.
Do not apply taper expectations to straight or relaxed denim.
rules.styling_tip: Tapered jeans mein width gradually reduce honi chahiye, abruptly nahi.

rules.name: outfit_linen_trouser_ease
rules.guideline: Linen trousers should retain enough ease to preserve their natural drape without appearing unnecessarily oversized.
recommendations: Allow natural room because linen garments often rely on relaxed drape.
Avoid excessive tightness that creates harsh pulling.
Judge linen trousers by their intended relaxed character.
rules.styling_tip: Linen trousers ko overly tight mat rakho; natural relaxed drape unki strength hai.

rules.name: outfit_tailored_trouser_ease
rules.guideline: Tailored trousers should provide controlled ease while preserving a clean structured silhouette.
recommendations: Avoid excessive fabric around the upper leg.
Maintain enough room for normal movement.
Use the trouser's intended formal structure as the baseline.
rules.styling_tip: Tailored trousers mein comfort aur clean structured shape ka balance rakho.

rules.name: outfit_garment_size_consistency
rules.guideline: When evaluating a complete outfit, garment sizes should create a coherent relationship across pieces rather than being judged independently.
recommendations: Consider how different fit categories interact across the outfit.
Do not assume identical labeled sizes produce identical visual proportions.
Focus on actual worn proportions rather than labels.
rules.styling_tip: Label size se zyada important hai ki garments body par actual mein kaise sit kar rahe hain.

rules.name: outfit_garment_size_label_uncertainty
rules.guideline: The AI should not infer exact garment size from visual appearance when the label or measurements are unavailable.
recommendations: Describe apparent fit instead of claiming an exact size.
Use terms such as fitted, regular, relaxed, or oversized when appropriate.
Avoid converting visual proportions into unsupported numeric sizing.
rules.styling_tip: Photo se exact S, M, L assume mat karo; apparent fit describe karo.
